/**
 * <!-- begin-user-doc -->
 * <!-- end-user-doc -->
 * <!-- begin-model-doc -->
 * Summary: Fills pipes with water up to the specified distance from the source using BFS.
 * Algorithm: If distance == 0, call fillBeginTile() to mark source as filled. Otherwise, for each coordinate in filledTiles from previous step, examine neighbors in the directions the pipe at that coordinate connects. If neighbor pipe exists and connects back (the outgoing direction of one pipe matches the opposite direction of the neighboring pipe) and is not already filled, mark it as filled and add to new filledTiles list. Update filledTiles with the new list. Update prevFilledDistance to current distance. Track number of newly filled tiles.
 * Related Features: filledTiles (List<Coordinate>), sourceCell (TerminationCell), prevFilledDistance (int), prevFilledTiles (int), cell (cellarray)
 * Related Classes: Coordinate, TerminationCell, Pipe, Direction, Pa19Helper
 * Input: distance: int - the current water flow distance (non-negative)
 * Output: void
 * Pre-condition: distance >= 0, sourceCell is defined and already marked as filled via fillBeginTile()
 * Post-condition: Water fills pipes reachable within the given distance from source according to pipe connectivity. The filledTiles list contains coordinates of all newly filled pipes at this distance.
 * <!-- end-model-doc -->
 * @model annotation="http://www.ustb.edu.cn/sei/mde/EnhancedCodeGen generated='true'"
 * @generated NOT
 */
public void fillTiles(final int distance)
{
    if (distance == 0) {
        fillBeginTile();
        // After fillBeginTile, if sourceCell is filled, add its coordinate to filledTiles
        if (getSourceCell() != null && getSourceCell().isFilled()) {
            Coordinate sourceCoord = getSourceCell().getCoord();
            getFilledTiles().add(sourceCoord);
        }
        setPrevFilledDistance(0);
        setPrevFilledTiles(1); // source cell was filled
        return;
    }
    
    // Get the current filledTiles from the previous step
    EList<Coordinate> currentFilledTiles = getFilledTiles();
    EList<Coordinate> newFilledTiles = new org.eclipse.emf.common.util.BasicEList<Coordinate>();
    Cell[][] cells = getCell();
    int newlyFilled = 0;
    
    for (Coordinate coord : currentFilledTiles) {
        int row = coord.getRow();
        int col = coord.getCol();
        Cell cell = cells[row][col];
        Pipe pipe = null;
        if (cell instanceof FillableCell) {
            pipe = ((FillableCell) cell).getPipe();
        } else if (cell instanceof TerminationCell) {
            // TerminationCell doesn't have a pipe, but has a pointingTo direction
            // We handle this case separately
            TerminationCell termCell = (TerminationCell) cell;
            if (termCell.isFilled()) {
                // Check neighbor in the direction it points to
                Direction dir = termCell.getPointingTo();
                int newRow = row;
                int newCol = col;
                if (dir == Direction.UP) newRow = row - 1;
                else if (dir == Direction.DOWN) newRow = row + 1;
                else if (dir == Direction.LEFT) newCol = col - 1;
                else if (dir == Direction.RIGHT) newCol = col + 1;
                
                if (newRow >= 0 && newRow < getRows() && newCol >= 0 && newCol < getCols()) {
                    Cell neighborCell = cells[newRow][newCol];
                    if (neighborCell instanceof FillableCell) {
                        Pipe neighborPipe = ((FillableCell) neighborCell).getPipe();
                        if (neighborPipe != null && !neighborPipe.isFilled()) {
                            // Check if neighbor connects back (opposite direction)
                            Direction opposite = getOpposite(dir);
                            if (neighborPipe.getConnections().contains(opposite)) {
                                neighborPipe.setFilled(true);
                                Coordinate newCoord = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createCoordinate();
                                newCoord.setRow(newRow);
                                newCoord.setCol(newCol);
                                newFilledTiles.add(newCoord);
                                newlyFilled++;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            continue;
        }
        
        if (pipe == null) continue;
        
        // For each direction the pipe connects to
        for (Direction dir : pipe.getConnections()) {
            int newRow = row;
            int newCol = col;
            if (dir == Direction.UP) newRow = row - 1;
            else if (dir == Direction.DOWN) newRow = row + 1;
            else if (dir == Direction.LEFT) newCol = col - 1;
            else if (dir == Direction.RIGHT) newCol = col + 1;
            
            // Check bounds
            if (newRow < 0 || newRow >= getRows() || newCol < 0 || newCol >= getCols()) continue;
            
            Cell neighborCell = cells[newRow][newCol];
            if (neighborCell instanceof FillableCell) {
                Pipe neighborPipe = ((FillableCell) neighborCell).getPipe();
                if (neighborPipe != null && !neighborPipe.isFilled()) {
                    // Check if neighbor connects back (the opposite direction)
                    Direction opposite = getOpposite(dir);
                    if (neighborPipe.getConnections().contains(opposite)) {
                        neighborPipe.setFilled(true);
                        Coordinate newCoord = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createCoordinate();
                        newCoord.setRow(newRow);
                        newCoord.setCol(newCol);
                        newFilledTiles.add(newCoord);
                        newlyFilled++;
                    }
                }
            } else if (neighborCell instanceof TerminationCell) {
                TerminationCell termCell = (TerminationCell) neighborCell;
                if (!termCell.isFilled()) {
                    Direction opposite = getOpposite(dir);
                    if (termCell.getPointingTo() == opposite) {
                        termCell.setFilled(true);
                        Coordinate newCoord = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createCoordinate();
                        newCoord.setRow(newRow);
                        newCoord.setCol(newCol);
                        newFilledTiles.add(newCoord);
                        newlyFilled++;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    // Update filledTiles with the new list
    getFilledTiles().clear();
    getFilledTiles().addAll(newFilledTiles);
    
    // Update prevFilledDistance and prevFilledTiles
    setPrevFilledDistance(distance);
    setPrevFilledTiles(newlyFilled);
}
/**
 * <!-- begin-user-doc -->
 * <!-- end-user-doc -->
 * <!-- begin-model-doc -->
 * Uses BFS to check if a path exists from sourceCell to sinkCell
 * <!-- end-model-doc -->
 * @model
 * @generated NOT
 */
public boolean checkPath()
{
    if (getSourceCell() == null || getSinkCell() == null) return false;
    
    Coordinate sourceCoord = getSourceCell().getCoord();
    Coordinate sinkCoord = getSinkCell().getCoord();
    
    // BFS
    java.util.Queue<Coordinate> queue = new java.util.LinkedList<>();
    java.util.Set<Coordinate> visited = new java.util.HashSet<>();
    
    queue.add(sourceCoord);
    visited.add(sourceCoord);
    
    Cell[][] cells = getCell();
    
    while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
        Coordinate current = queue.poll();
        
        if (current.getRow() == sinkCoord.getRow() && current.getCol() == sinkCoord.getCol()) {
            return true;
        }
        
        int row = current.getRow();
        int col = current.getCol();
        Cell cell = cells[row][col];
        
        EList<Direction> connections = null;
        if (cell instanceof FillableCell) {
            Pipe pipe = ((FillableCell) cell).getPipe();
            if (pipe == null) continue;
            connections = pipe.getConnections();
        } else if (cell instanceof TerminationCell) {
            TerminationCell termCell = (TerminationCell) cell;
            if (!termCell.isFilled()) continue;
            connections = new org.eclipse.emf.common.util.BasicEList<Direction>();
            connections.add(termCell.getPointingTo());
        } else {
            continue;
        }
        
        for (Direction dir : connections) {
            int newRow = row;
            int newCol = col;
            if (dir == Direction.UP) newRow = row - 1;
            else if (dir == Direction.DOWN) newRow = row + 1;
            else if (dir == Direction.LEFT) newCol = col - 1;
            else if (dir == Direction.RIGHT) newCol = col + 1;
            
            if (newRow < 0 || newRow >= getRows() || newCol < 0 || newCol >= getCols()) continue;
            
            Coordinate neighbor = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createCoordinate();
            neighbor.setRow(newRow);
            neighbor.setCol(newCol);
            
            if (visited.contains(neighbor)) continue;
            
            Cell neighborCell = cells[newRow][newCol];
            if (neighborCell instanceof FillableCell) {
                Pipe neighborPipe = ((FillableCell) neighborCell).getPipe();
                if (neighborPipe == null) continue;
                Direction opposite = getOpposite(dir);
                if (neighborPipe.getConnections().contains(opposite)) {
                    visited.add(neighbor);
                    queue.add(neighbor);
                }
            } else if (neighborCell instanceof TerminationCell) {
                TerminationCell termCell = (TerminationCell) neighborCell;
                if (!termCell.isFilled()) continue;
                Direction opposite = getOpposite(dir);
                if (termCell.getPointingTo() == opposite) {
                    visited.add(neighbor);
                    queue.add(neighbor);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    return false;
}

/**
 * <!-- begin-user-doc -->
 * <!-- end-user-doc -->
 * @model
 * @generated NOT
 */
public boolean checkPath()
{
    if (getSourceCell() == null || getSinkCell() == null) {
        return false;
    }
    
    Coordinate sourceCoord = getSourceCell().getCoord();
    Coordinate sinkCoord = getSinkCell().getCoord();
    
    // BFS using a queue
    java.util.Queue<Coordinate> queue = new java.util.LinkedList<Coordinate>();
    boolean[][] visited = new boolean[getRows()][getCols()];
    
    queue.add(sourceCoord);
    visited[sourceCoord.getRow()][sourceCoord.getCol()] = true;
    
    Cell[][] cells = getCell();
    
    while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
        Coordinate current = queue.poll();
        int row = current.getRow();
        int col = current.getCol();
        
        // Check if we reached the sink
        if (row == sinkCoord.getRow() && col == sinkCoord.getCol()) {
            return true;
        }
        
        // Get the connections from the current cell
        EList<Direction> connections = new org.eclipse.emf.common.util.BasicEList<Direction>();
        Cell cell = cells[row][col];
        if (cell instanceof FillableCell) {
            Pipe pipe = ((FillableCell) cell).getPipe();
            if (pipe != null) {
                connections.addAll(pipe.getConnections());
            }
        } else if (cell instanceof TerminationCell) {
            TerminationCell termCell = (TerminationCell) cell;
            if (termCell.isFilled()) {
                connections.add(termCell.getPointingTo());
            }
        }
        
        // Explore neighbors
        for (Direction dir : connections) {
            int newRow = row;
            int newCol = col;
            if (dir == Direction.UP) newRow = row - 1;
            else if (dir == Direction.DOWN) newRow = row + 1;
            else if (dir == Direction.LEFT) newCol = col - 1;
            else if (dir == Direction.RIGHT) newCol = col + 1;
            
            // Check bounds
            if (newRow < 0 || newRow >= getRows() || newCol < 0 || newCol >= getCols()) continue;
            if (visited[newRow][newCol]) continue;
            
            Cell neighborCell = cells[newRow][newCol];
            Direction opposite = getOpposite(dir);
            
            boolean connected = false;
            if (neighborCell instanceof FillableCell) {
                Pipe neighborPipe = ((FillableCell) neighborCell).getPipe();
                if (neighborPipe != null && neighborPipe.getConnections().contains(opposite)) {
                    connected = true;
                }
            } else if (neighborCell instanceof TerminationCell) {
                TerminationCell termCell = (TerminationCell) neighborCell;
                if (termCell.isFilled() && termCell.getPointingTo() == opposite) {
                    connected = true;
                }
            }
            
            if (connected) {
                visited[newRow][newCol] = true;
                Coordinate neighborCoord = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createCoordinate();
                neighborCoord.setRow(newRow);
                neighborCoord.setCol(newCol);
                queue.add(neighborCoord);
            }
        }
    }
    
    return false;
}

public boolean checkPath()
{
    if (getSourceCell() == null || getSinkCell() == null) {
        return false;
    }
    
    // BFS
    java.util.Queue<Coordinate> queue = new java.util.LinkedList<>();
    java.util.Set<Coordinate> visited = new java.util.HashSet<>();
    
    Coordinate sourceCoord = getSourceCell().getCoord();
    queue.add(sourceCoord);
    visited.add(sourceCoord);
    
    Pa19Helper helper = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createPa19Helper();
    
    while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
        Coordinate current = queue.poll();
        
        // Check if we reached the sink
        Cell currentCell = getCell()[current.getRow()][current.getCol()];
        
        if (currentCell instanceof TerminationCell) {
            TerminationCell termCell = (TerminationCell) currentCell;
            if (termCell == getSinkCell() || termCell.getType() == getSinkCell().getType()) {
                // Actually, let's check if it IS the sink cell
                if (current.equals(getSinkCell().getCoord())) {
                    return true;
                }
            }
        }
        
        // Get connections from this cell
        EList<Direction> connections = new org.eclipse.emf.common.util.BasicEList<Direction>();
        if (currentCell instanceof FillableCell) {
            FillableCell fillable = (FillableCell) currentCell;
            if (fillable.getPipe() != null) {
                connections = fillable.getPipe().getConnections();
            }
        } else if (currentCell instanceof TerminationCell) {
            TerminationCell termCell = (TerminationCell) currentCell;
            connections.add(termCell.getPointingTo());
        }
        
        for (Direction dir : connections) {
            Coordinate offset = helper.getOffset(dir);
            Coordinate neighborCoord = current.add(offset);
            int nRow = neighborCoord.getRow();
            int nCol = neighborCoord.getCol();
            
            if (nRow >= 0 && nRow < getRows() && nCol >= 0 && nCol < getCols() && !visited.contains(neighborCoord)) {
                Cell neighborCell = getCell()[nRow][nCol];
                Direction opposite = helper.getOpposite(dir);
                
                boolean canEnter = false;
                if (neighborCell instanceof FillableCell) {
                    FillableCell neighborFillable = (FillableCell) neighborCell;
                    if (neighborFillable.getPipe() != null && neighborFillable.getPipe().getConnections().contains(opposite)) {
                        canEnter = true;
                    }
                } else if (neighborCell instanceof TerminationCell) {
                    TerminationCell neighborTerm = (TerminationCell) neighborCell;
                    if (neighborTerm.getPointingTo() == opposite) {
                        canEnter = true;
                    }
                }
                
                if (canEnter) {
                    visited.add(neighborCoord);
                    queue.add(neighborCoord);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    return false;
}

public void fillTiles(final int distance) {
    if (distance == 0) {
        fillBeginTile();
        // Add source cell's coordinate to filledTiles
        EList<Coordinate> newFilledTiles = new BasicEList<Coordinate>();
        newFilledTiles.add(getSourceCell().getCoord());
        getFilledTiles().clear();
        getFilledTiles().addAll(newFilledTiles);
        prevFilledTiles = 1;
        prevFilledDistance = 0;
    } else {
        EList<Coordinate> newFilledTiles = new BasicEList<Coordinate>();
        Pa19Helper helper = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createPa19Helper();
        for (Coordinate coord : getFilledTiles()) {
            Cell cell = getCell()[coord.getRow()][coord.getCol()];
            if (cell instanceof FillableCell) {
                Pipe pipe = ((FillableCell) cell).getPipe();
                if (pipe != null) {
                    for (Direction dir : pipe.getConnections()) {
                        Coordinate offset = helper.getOffset(dir);
                        Coordinate neighborCoord = coord.add(offset);
                        int nRow = neighborCoord.getRow();
                        int nCol = neighborCoord.getCol();
                        // Check bounds
                        if (nRow >= 0 && nRow < getRows() && nCol >= 0 && nCol < getCols()) {
                            Cell neighborCell = getCell()[nRow][nCol];
                            if (neighborCell instanceof FillableCell) {
                                Pipe neighborPipe = ((FillableCell) neighborCell).getPipe();
                                if (neighborPipe != null && !neighborPipe.isFilled()) {
                                    Direction opposite = helper.getOpposite(dir);
                                    if (neighborPipe.getConnections().contains(opposite)) {
                                        neighborPipe.setFilled(true);
                                        newFilledTiles.add(neighborCoord);
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        getFilledTiles().clear();
        getFilledTiles().addAll(newFilledTiles);
        prevFilledTiles = newFilledTiles.size();
        prevFilledDistance = distance;
    }
}
public boolean checkPath() {
    if (getSourceCell() == null || getSinkCell() == null) return false;
    
    Coordinate sourceCoord = getSourceCell().getCoord();
    Coordinate sinkCoord = getSinkCell().getCoord();
    
    // BFS
    java.util.Queue<Coordinate> queue = new java.util.LinkedList<>();
    java.util.Set<Coordinate> visited = new java.util.HashSet<>();
    
    queue.add(sourceCoord);
    visited.add(sourceCoord);
    
    while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
        Coordinate current = queue.poll();
        
        if (current.getRow() == sinkCoord.getRow() && current.getCol() == sinkCoord.getCol()) {
            return true;
        }
        
        Cell currentCell = getCell()[current.getRow()][current.getCol()];
        java.util.List<Direction> directions = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        
        if (currentCell instanceof TerminationCell) {
            Direction dir = ((TerminationCell) currentCell).getPointingTo();
            if (dir != null) {
                directions.add(dir);
            }
        } else if (currentCell instanceof FillableCell) {
            Pipe pipe = ((FillableCell) currentCell).getPipe();
            if (pipe != null) {
                directions.addAll(pipe.getConnections());
            }
        }
        
        Pa19Helper helper = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createPa19Helper();
        for (Direction dir : directions) {
            Coordinate offset = helper.getOffset(dir);
            Coordinate neighbor = current.add(offset);
            int nRow = neighbor.getRow();
            int nCol = neighbor.getCol();
            
            if (nRow >= 0 && nRow < getRows() && nCol >= 0 && nCol < getCols() && !visited.contains(neighbor)) {
                Cell neighborCell = getCell()[nRow][nCol];
                if (neighborCell instanceof FillableCell) {
                    Pipe neighborPipe = ((FillableCell) neighborCell).getPipe();
                    if (neighborPipe != null) {
                        Direction opposite = helper.getOpposite(dir);
                        if (neighborPipe.getConnections().contains(opposite)) {
                            visited.add(neighbor);
                            queue.add(neighbor);
                        }
                    }
                } else if (neighborCell instanceof TerminationCell) {
                    // Check if the termination cell's pointingTo direction is opposite of current direction
                    Direction opposite = helper.getOpposite(dir);
                    if (((TerminationCell) neighborCell).getPointingTo() == opposite) {
                        visited.add(neighbor);
                        queue.add(neighbor);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    return false;
}

public boolean tryPlacePipe(final int row, final int col, final Pipe pipe) {
    // Validate bounds
    if (row < 1 || row > getRows() - 2 || col < 1 || col > getCols() - 2) {
        return false;
    }
    Cell targetCell = getCell()[row][col];
    if (targetCell instanceof FillableCell) {
        FillableCell fillableCell = (FillableCell) targetCell;
        if (fillableCell.getPipe() == null) {
            fillableCell.setPipe(pipe);
            return true;
        }
    }
    return false;
}

public void undo(final Coordinate coord) {

        FillableCell fillableCell = (FillableCell) targetCell;
        if (fillableCell.getPipe() != null) {
            fillableCell.setPipe(null);
        }
    }
}

   * <!-- begin-user-doc -->

   * <!-- begin-model-doc -->
   * Summary: Attempts to place a pipe at the specified row and column coordinate.
   * Algorithm: Validate that row is between 1 and rows-2, col is between 1 and cols-2. Check that the cell at that coordinate is a FillableCell and has no pipe. If valid, set the cell's pipe to the given pipe and return true. Otherwise return false.
   * Related Features: cell (cellarray), rows (int), cols (int)

 * Algorithm: Validate that row is between 1 and rows-2, col is between 1 and cols-2. Check that the cell at that coordinate is a FillableCell and has no pipe. If valid, set the cell's pipe to the given pipe and return true. Otherwise return false.

public boolean tryPlacePipe(final int row, final int col, final Pipe pipe)

```java
public void fillTiles(final int distance)
{
    if (distance == 0) {
        fillBeginTile();
        return;
    }
    EList<Coordinate> newFilledTiles = new BasicEList<Coordinate>();
    Pa19Helper helper = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createPa19Helper();
    for (Coordinate coord : getFilledTiles()) {
        Cell cell = getCell()[coord.getRow()][coord.getCol()];
        if (cell instanceof FillableCell) {
            FillableCell fillableCell = (FillableCell) cell;
            Pipe pipe = fillableCell.getPipe();
            if (pipe != null) {
                for (Direction dir : pipe.getConnections()) {
                    Coordinate offset = helper.getOffset(dir);
                    Coordinate neighborCoord = coord.add(offset);
                    int nRow = neighborCoord.getRow();
                    int nCol = neighborCoord.getCol();
                    if (nRow >= 0 && nRow < getRows() && nCol >= 0 && nCol < getCols()) {
                        Cell neighborCell = getCell()[nRow][nCol];
                        if (neighborCell instanceof FillableCell) {
                            FillableCell neighborFillable = (FillableCell) neighborCell;
                            Pipe neighborPipe = neighborFillable.getPipe();
                            if (neighborPipe != null && !neighborPipe.isFilled()) {
                                Direction opposite = helper.getOpposite(dir);
                                if (neighborPipe.getConnections().contains(opposite)) {
                                    neighborPipe.setFilled(true);
                                    newFilledTiles.add(neighborCoord);
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    getFilledTiles().clear();
    getFilledTiles().addAll(newFilledTiles);
    setPrevFilledDistance(distance);
    setPrevFilledTiles(newFilledTiles.size());
}

```java
public boolean checkPath()
{
    if (getSourceCell() == null || getSinkCell() == null) {
        return false;
    }
    // BFS
    Set<Coordinate> visited = new java.util.HashSet<Coordinate>();
    java.util.Queue<Coordinate> queue = new java.util.LinkedList<Coordinate>();
    Coordinate startCoord = getSourceCell().getCoord();
    queue.add(startCoord);
    visited.add(startCoord);
    Pa19Helper helper = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createPa19Helper();
    while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
        Coordinate current = queue.poll();
        Cell currentCell = getCell()[current.getRow()][current.getCol()];
        if (currentCell instanceof TerminationCell) {
            TerminationCell termCell = (TerminationCell) currentCell;
            if (termCell == getSinkCell() || termCell.equals(getSinkCell())) {
                return true;
            }
        }
        // Get directions from the pipe at this cell
        if (currentCell instanceof FillableCell) {
            FillableCell fillableCell = (FillableCell) currentCell;
            Pipe pipe = fillableCell.getPipe();
            if (pipe != null && pipe.isFilled()) {
                for (Direction dir : pipe.getConnections()) {
                    Coordinate offset = helper.getOffset(dir);
                    Coordinate neighborCoord = current.add(offset);
                    if (!visited.contains(neighborCoord)) {
                        int nRow = neighborCoord.getRow();
                        int nCol = neighborCoord.getCol();
                        if (nRow >= 0 && nRow < getRows() && nCol >= 0 && nCol < getCols()) {
                            Cell neighborCell = getCell()[nRow][nCol];
                            if (neighborCell instanceof FillableCell) {
                                FillableCell neighborFillable = (FillableCell) neighborCell;
                                Pipe neighborPipe = neighborFillable.getPipe();
                                if (neighborPipe != null && neighborPipe.isFilled()) {
                                    Direction opposite = helper.getOpposite(dir);
                                    if (neighborPipe.getConnections().contains(opposite)) {
                                        visited.add(neighborCoord);
                                        queue.add(neighborCoord);
                                    }
                                }
                            } else if (neighborCell instanceof TerminationCell) {
                                // Check if this termination cell connects back
                                TerminationCell termNeighbor = (TerminationCell) neighborCell;
                                // A termination cell is considered reachable if it's the sink
                                visited.add(neighborCoord);
                                queue.add(neighborCoord);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        } else if (currentCell instanceof TerminationCell) {
            TerminationCell termCell = (TerminationCell) currentCell;
            if (termCell.isFilled()) {
                Direction pointingTo = termCell.getPointingTo();
                Coordinate offset = helper.getOffset(pointingTo);
                Coordinate neighborCoord = current.add(offset);
                if (!visited.contains(neighborCoord)) {
                    int nRow = neighborCoord.getRow();
                    int nCol = neighborCoord.getCol();
                    if (nRow >= 0 && nRow < getRows() && nCol >= 0 && nCol < getCols()) {
                        visited.add(neighborCoord);
                        queue.add(neighborCoord);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return false;
}

If neighbor pipe exists and connects back (the outgoing direction of one pipe matches the opposite direction of the neighboring pipe) and is not already filled, mark it as filled and add to new filledTiles list. Update filledTiles with the new list. Update prevFilledDistance to current distance. Track number of newly filled tiles.
 * Related Features: filledTiles (List<Coordinate>), sourceCell (TerminationCell), prevFilledDistance (int), prevFilledTiles (int), cell (cellarray)
 * Related Classes: Coordinate, TerminationCell, Pipe, Direction, Pa19Helper
 * Input: distance: int - the current water flow distance (non-negative)
 * Output: void
 * Pre-condition: distance >= 0, sourceCell is defined and already marked as filled via fillBeginTile()
 * Post-condition: Water fills pipes reachable within the given distance from source according to pipe connectivity. The filledTiles list contains coordinates of all newly filled pipes at this distance.
 * <!-- end-model-doc -->
 * @model annotation="http://www.ustb.edu.cn/sei/mde/EnhancedCodeGen generated='true'"
 * @generated NOT
 */
public void fillTiles(final int distance)
{
    if (distance == 0) {
        fillBeginTile();
        // Initialize filledTiles with the source cell coordinate
        if (getSourceCell() != null) {
            getFilledTiles().clear();
            getFilledTiles().add(getSourceCell().getCoord());
        }
        prevFilledDistance = 0;
        prevFilledTiles = 1;
        return;
    }
    
    EList<Coordinate> newFilledTiles = new BasicEList<Coordinate>();
    Pa19Helper helper = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createPa19Helper();
    
    for (Coordinate coord : getFilledTiles()) {
        Cell cell = getCell()[coord.getRow()][coord.getCol()];
        if (cell instanceof FillableCell) {
            FillableCell fillableCell = (FillableCell) cell;
            Pipe pipe = fillableCell.getPipe();
            if (pipe != null) {
                for (Direction dir : pipe.getConnections()) {
                    Coordinate offset = helper.getOffset(dir);
                    Coordinate neighborCoord = coord.add(offset);
                    int nRow = neighborCoord.getRow();
                    int nCol = neighborCoord.getCol();
                    if (nRow >= 0 && nRow < getRows() && nCol >= 0 && nCol < getCols()) {
                        Cell neighborCell = getCell()[nRow][nCol];
                        if (neighborCell instanceof FillableCell) {
                            FillableCell neighborFillable = (FillableCell) neighborCell;
                            Pipe neighborPipe = neighborFillable.getPipe();
                            if (neighborPipe != null && !neighborPipe.isFilled()) {
                                Direction opposite = helper.getOpposite(dir);
                                if (neighborPipe.getConnections().contains(opposite)) {
                                    neighborPipe.setFilled(true);
                                    newFilledTiles.add(neighborCoord);
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    getFilledTiles().clear();
    getFilledTiles().addAll(newFilledTiles);
    prevFilledDistance = distance;
    prevFilledTiles = newFilledTiles.size();
}
/**
 * <!-- begin-user-doc -->
 * <!-- end-user-doc -->
 * <!-- begin-model-doc -->
 * Uses BFS to check if a path exists from sourceCell to sinkCell
 * <!-- end-model-doc -->
 * @model
 * @generated NOT
 */
public boolean checkPath()
{
    if (getSourceCell() == null || getSinkCell() == null) {
        return false;
    }
    
    java.util.Set<Coordinate> visited = new java.util.HashSet<Coordinate>();
    java.util.Queue<Coordinate> queue = new java.util.LinkedList<Coordinate>();
    Pa19Helper helper = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createPa19Helper();
    
    Coordinate startCoord = getSourceCell().getCoord();
    queue.add(startCoord);
    visited.add(startCoord);
    
    while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
        Coordinate current = queue.poll();
        
        // Check if current cell is the sink
        Cell currentCell = getCell()[current.getRow()][current.getCol()];
        if (currentCell == getSinkCell()) {
            return true;
        }
        
        // Get directions to explore
        java.util.List<Direction> directions = new java.util.ArrayList<Direction>();
        
        if (currentCell instanceof TerminationCell) {
            TerminationCell termCell = (TerminationCell) currentCell;
            if (termCell.isFilled()) {
                directions.add(termCell.getPointingTo());
            }
        } else if (currentCell instanceof FillableCell) {
            FillableCell fillableCell = (FillableCell) currentCell;
            Pipe pipe = fillableCell.getPipe();
            if (pipe != null && pipe.isFilled()) {
                directions.addAll(pipe.getConnections());
            }
        }
        
        for (Direction dir : directions) {
            Coordinate offset = helper.getOffset(dir);
            Coordinate neighborCoord = current.add(offset);
            
            if (!visited.contains(neighborCoord)) {
                int nRow = neighborCoord.getRow();
                int nCol = neighborCoord.getCol();
                if (nRow >= 0 && nRow < getRows() && nCol >= 0 && nCol < getCols()) {
                    Cell neighborCell = getCell()[nRow][nCol];
                    
                    // Check if we can enter the neighbor
                    boolean canEnter = false;
                    if (neighborCell instanceof TerminationCell) {
                        TerminationCell termNeighbor = (TerminationCell) neighborCell;
                        if (termNeighbor.isFilled()) {
                            Direction opposite = helper.getOpposite(dir);
                            if (termNeighbor.getPointingTo() == opposite) {
                                canEnter = true;
                            }
                        }
                    } else if (neighborCell instanceof FillableCell) {
                        FillableCell neighborFillable = (FillableCell) neighborCell;
                        Pipe neighborPipe = neighborFillable.getPipe();
                        if (neighborPipe != null && neighborPipe.isFilled()) {
                            Direction opposite = helper.getOpposite(dir);
                            if (neighborPipe.getConnections().contains(opposite)) {
                                canEnter = true;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    
                    if (canEnter) {
                        visited.add(neighborCoord);
                        queue.add(neighborCoord);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    return false;
}

public boolean hasLost()

  /**
   * <!-- begin-user-doc -->
   * <!-- end-user-doc -->
   * <!-- begin-model-doc -->
   * Summary: Attempts to place a pipe at the specified row and column coordinate.
   * Algorithm: Validate that row is between 1 and rows-2, col is between 1 and cols-2. Check that the cell at that coordinate is a FillableCell and has no pipe. If valid, set the cell's pipe to the given pipe and return true. Otherwise return false.
   * Related Features: cell (cellarray), rows (int), cols (int)
   * Related Classes: FillableCell, Pipe, Coordinate
   * Input: row: int (1-based internal row index), col: char (column letter 'A'-'Z' mapping to 1-26), pipe: Pipe - the pipe to place
   * Output: boolean - true if placement was successful, false otherwise
   * Pre-condition: The coordinate derived from row and col is within the playable area (row between 1 and rows-2, column letter maps to column index between 1 and cols-2)

- When possible, call getter/setter methods to access field values. Do not read/write raw fields derived from the class diagram.

      case Pa19Package.MAP__SINK_CELL:

/**
 * <!-- begin-user-doc -->
 * <!-- end-user-doc -->
 * <!-- begin-model-doc -->
 * Summary: Attempts to place a pipe at the specified row and column coordinate.
 * Algorithm: Validate that row is between 1 and rows-2, col is between 1 and cols-2. Check that the cell at that coordinate is a FillableCell and has no pipe. If valid, set the cell's pipe to the given pipe and return true. Otherwise return false.
 * Related Features: cell (cellarray), rows (int), cols (int)
 * Related Classes: FillableCell, Pipe, Coordinate
 * Input: row: int (1-based internal row index), col: char (column letter 'A'-'Z' mapping to 1-26), pipe: Pipe - the pipe to place
 * Output: boolean - true if placement was successful, false otherwise
 * Pre-condition: The coordinate derived from row and col is within the playable area (row between 1 and rows-2, column letter maps to column index between 1 and cols-2)
 * Post-condition: If successful, the specified FillableCell now contains the given pipe.
 * <!-- end-model-doc -->
 * @model annotation="http://www.ustb.edu.cn/sei/mde/EnhancedCodeGen generated='true'"
 * @generated NOT
 */
public boolean tryPlacePipe(final int row, final int col, final Pipe pipe)
{
    if (row < 1 || row > getRows() - 2 || col < 1 || col > getCols() - 2) {
        return false;
    }
    Cell targetCell = getCell()[row][col];
    if (targetCell instanceof FillableCell) {
        FillableCell fillableCell = (FillableCell) targetCell;
        if (fillableCell.getPipe() == null) {
            fillableCell.setPipe(pipe);
            return true;
        }
    }
    return false;
}

                    int nr = neighborCoord.getRow();

                        Cell neighborCell = getCell()[nr][nc];
                        if (neighborCell instanceof FillableCell) {
                            FillableCell neighborFillable = (FillableCell) neighborCell;
                            Pipe neighborPipe = neighborFillable.getPipe();

                                // Check if neighbor connects back
                                if (neighborPipe.getConnections().contains(opposite)) {
                                    neighborPipe.setFilled(true);
                                    newFilledTiles.add(neighborCoord);
                                }

                        } else if (neighborCell instanceof TerminationCell) {

                            if (!termCell.isFilled()) {

                                if (termCell.getPointingTo() == opposite) {

                                    newFilledTiles.add(neighborCoord);

                            }

            }

For `checkPath()`:
```java
public boolean checkPath()
{
    if (getSourceCell() == null || getSinkCell() == null) {
        return false;
    }
    
    java.util.Set<Coordinate> visited = new java.util.HashSet<Coordinate>();
    java.util.Queue<Coordinate> queue = new java.util.LinkedList<Coordinate>();
    Pa19Helper helper = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createPa19Helper();
    
    Coordinate sourceCoord = getSourceCell().getCoord();
    visited.add(sourceCoord);
    queue.add(sourceCoord);
    
    while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
        Coordinate current = queue.poll();
        
        if (current.equals(getSinkCell().getCoord())) {
            return true;
        }
        
        int r = current.getRow();
        int c = current.getCol();
        Cell cell = getCell()[r][c];
        
        EList<Direction> directions;
        if (cell instanceof FillableCell) {
            FillableCell fc = (FillableCell) cell;
            if (fc.getPipe() == null) continue;
            directions = fc.getPipe().getConnections();
        } else if (cell instanceof TerminationCell) {
            TerminationCell tc = (TerminationCell) cell;
            if (!tc.isFilled()) continue;
            directions = new org.eclipse.emf.common.util.BasicEList<Direction>();
            directions.add(tc.getPointingTo());
        } else {
            continue;
        }
        
        for (Direction dir : directions) {
            Direction opposite = helper.getOpposite(dir);
            Coordinate offset = helper.getOffset(dir);
            Coordinate neighborCoord = current.add(offset);
            
            if (!visited.contains(neighborCoord)) {
                int nr = neighborCoord.getRow();
                int nc = neighborCoord.getCol();
                if (nr >= 0 && nr < getRows() && nc >= 0 && nc < getCols()) {
                    Cell neighborCell = getCell()[nr][nc];
                    boolean canEnter = false;
                    
                    if (neighborCell instanceof FillableCell) {
                        FillableCell nfc = (FillableCell) neighborCell;
                        if (nfc.getPipe() != null && nfc.getPipe().getConnections().contains(opposite)) {
                            canEnter = true;
                        }
                    } else if (neighborCell instanceof TerminationCell) {
                        TerminationCell ntc = (TerminationCell) neighborCell;
                        if (ntc.getPointingTo() == opposite) {
                            canEnter = true;
                        }
                    }
                    
                    if (canEnter) {
                        visited.add(neighborCoord);
                        queue.add(neighborCoord);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    return false;
}
```

```java
public void fillTiles(final int distance)
{
    if (distance == 0) {
        fillBeginTile();
        if (getSourceCell() != null && getSourceCell().getCoord() != null) {
            getFilledTiles().add(getSourceCell().getCoord());
        }
        prevFilledDistance = 0;
        prevFilledTiles = 1;
        return;
    }
    
    EList<Coordinate> newFilledTiles = new BasicEList<Coordinate>();
    Pa19Helper helper = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createPa19Helper();
    
    for (Coordinate coord : getFilledTiles()) {
        int r = coord.getRow();
        int c = coord.getCol();
        Cell cell = getCell()[r][c];
        if (cell instanceof FillableCell) {
            FillableCell fillableCell = (FillableCell) cell;
            Pipe pipe = fillableCell.getPipe();
            if (pipe != null && pipe.isFilled()) {
                for (Direction dir : pipe.getConnections()) {
                    Direction opposite = helper.getOpposite(dir);
                    Coordinate offset = helper.getOffset(dir);
                    Coordinate neighborCoord = coord.add(offset);
                    int nr = neighborCoord.getRow();
                    int nc = neighborCoord.getCol();
                    if (nr >= 0 && nr < getRows() && nc >= 0 && nc < getCols()) {
                        Cell neighborCell = getCell()[nr][nc];
                        if (neighborCell instanceof FillableCell) {
                            FillableCell neighborFillable = (FillableCell) neighborCell;
                            Pipe neighborPipe = neighborFillable.getPipe();
                            if (neighborPipe != null && !neighborPipe.isFilled() && neighborPipe.getConnections().contains(opposite)) {
                                neighborPipe.setFilled(true);
                                newFilledTiles.add(neighborCoord);
                            }
                        } else if (neighborCell instanceof TerminationCell) {
                            TerminationCell termCell = (TerminationCell) neighborCell;
                            if (!termCell.isFilled() && termCell.getPointingTo() == opposite) {
                                termCell.setFilled(true);
                                newFilledTiles.add(neighborCoord);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    prevFilledTiles = newFilledTiles.size();
    prevFilledDistance = distance;
    
    getFilledTiles().clear();
    getFilledTiles().addAll(newFilledTiles);
}

   * Summary: Attempts to place a pipe at the specified row and column coordinate.
   * Algorithm: Validate that row is between 1 and rows-2, col is between 1 and cols-2. Check that the cell at that coordinate is a FillableCell and has no pipe. If valid, set the cell's pipe to the given pipe and return true. Otherwise return false.
   * Related Features: cell (cellarray), rows (int), cols (int)
   * Related Classes: FillableCell, Pipe, Coordinate
   * Input: row: int (1-based internal row index), col: char (column letter 'A'-'Z' mapping to 1-26), pipe: Pipe - the pipe to place
   * Output: boolean - true if placement was successful, false otherwise
   * Pre-condition: The coordinate derived from row and col is within the playable area (row between 1 and rows-2, column letter maps to column index between 1 and cols-2)
   * Post-condition: If successful, the specified FillableCell now contains the given pipe.
   * <!-- end-model-doc -->
   * @model annotation="http://www.ustb.edu.cn/sei/mde/EnhancedCodeGen generated='true'"
   * @generated NOT

  public boolean tryPlacePipe(final int row, final int col, final Pipe pipe)
  {

      return false;
    }
    Cell targetCell = getCell()[row][col];
    if (targetCell instanceof FillableCell) {

   * Related Features: cell (cellarray)
   * Related Classes: FillableCell, Coordinate, Pipe
   * Input: coord: Coordinate - the position to clear (must be a valid internal coordinate within playable area)
   * Output: void
   * Pre-condition: coord is a valid internal coordinate (row between 1 and rows-2, col between 1 and cols-2)
   * Post-condition: The FillableCell at the given coordinate no longer contains a pipe.
   * <!-- end-model-doc -->
   * @model annotation="http://www.ustb.edu.cn/sei/mde/EnhancedCodeGen generated='true'"
   * @generated NOT
   */
  public void undo(final Coordinate coord)
  {
    int r = coord.getRow();
    int c = coord.getCol();
    if (r >= 1 && r <= getRows() - 2 && c >= 1 && c <= getCols() - 2) {
      Cell targetCell = getCell()[r][c];
      if (targetCell instanceof FillableCell) {
        FillableCell fillableCell = (FillableCell) targetCell;
        if (fillableCell.getPipe() != null) {
          fillableCell.setPipe(null);
        }
      }
    }
  }

  /**
   * <!-- begin-user-doc -->
   * <!-- end-user-doc -->
   * @model annotation="http://www.ustb.edu.cn/sei/mde/EnhancedCodeGen generated='manual'"
   * @generated

  public void fillBeginTile()
  {
    if (this.getSourceCell() != null) {
                this.getSourceCell().setFilled(true);
            }
        
  }

  /**
   * <!-- begin-user-doc -->
   * <!-- end-user-doc -->
   * <!-- begin-model-doc -->
   * Summary: Fills pipes with water up to the specified distance from the source using BFS.
   * Algorithm: If distance == 0, call fillBeginTile() to mark source as filled. Otherwise, for each coordinate in filledTiles from previous step, examine neighbors in the directions the pipe at that coordinate connects. If neighbor pipe exists and connects back (the outgoing direction of one pipe matches the opposite direction of the neighboring pipe) and is not already filled, mark it as filled and add to new filledTiles list. Update filledTiles with the new list. Update prevFilledDistance to current distance. Track number of newly filled tiles.
   * Related Features: filledTiles (List<Coordinate>), sourceCell (TerminationCell), prevFilledDistance (int), prevFilledTiles (int), cell (cellarray)
   * Related Classes: Coordinate, TerminationCell, Pipe, Direction, Pa19Helper
   * Input: distance: int - the current water flow distance (non-negative)
   * Output: void
   * Pre-condition: distance >= 0, sourceCell is defined and already marked as filled via fillBeginTile()
   * Post-condition: Water fills pipes reachable within the given distance from source according to pipe connectivity. The filledTiles list contains coordinates of all newly filled pipes at this distance.
   * <!-- end-model-doc -->
   * @model annotation="http://www.ustb.edu.cn/sei/mde/EnhancedCodeGen generated='true'"
   * @generated NOT
   */
  public void fillTiles(final int distance)
  {
    if (distance == 0) {
      fillBeginTile();
      getFilledTiles().clear();
      if (getSourceCell() != null && getSourceCell().getCoord() != null) {
        getFilledTiles().add(getSourceCell().getCoord());
      }
      prevFilledDistance = 0;
      prevFilledTiles = 1;
      return;
    }
    
    EList<Coordinate> newFilledTiles = new BasicEList<Coordinate>();
    Pa19Helper helper = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createPa19Helper();
    
    for (Coordinate coord : getFilledTiles()) {
      int r = coord.getRow();
      int c = coord.getCol();
      Cell cell = getCell()[r][c];
      EList<Direction> directions = new BasicEList<Direction>();
      
      if (cell instanceof FillableCell) {
        FillableCell fillableCell = (FillableCell) cell;
        Pipe pipe = fillableCell.getPipe();
        if (pipe != null && pipe.isFilled()) {
          directions.addAll(pipe.getConnections());
        }
      } else if (cell instanceof TerminationCell) {
        TerminationCell termCell = (TerminationCell) cell;
        if (termCell.isFilled()) {
          directions.add(termCell.getPointingTo());
        }
      }
      
      for (Direction dir : directions) {
        Direction opposite = helper.getOpposite(dir);
        Coordinate offset = helper.getOffset(dir);
        Coordinate neighborCoord = coord.add(offset);
        int nr = neighborCoord.getRow();
        int nc = neighborCoord.getCol();
        if (nr >= 0 && nr < getRows() && nc >= 0 && nc < getCols()) {
          Cell neighborCell = getCell()[nr][nc];
          if (neighborCell instanceof FillableCell) {
            FillableCell neighborFillable = (FillableCell) neighborCell;
            Pipe neighborPipe = neighborFillable.getPipe();
            if (neighborPipe != null && !neighborPipe.isFilled() && neighborPipe.getConnections().contains(opposite)) {
              neighborPipe.setFilled(true);
              newFilledTiles.add(neighborCoord);
            }
          } else if (neighborCell instanceof TerminationCell) {
            TerminationCell neighborTerm = (TerminationCell) neighborCell;
            if (!neighborTerm.isFilled() && neighborTerm.getPointingTo() == opposite) {
              neighborTerm.setFilled(true);
              newFilledTiles.add(neighborCoord);
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
    
    prevFilledTiles = newFilledTiles.size();
    prevFilledDistance = distance;
    
    getFilledTiles().clear();
    getFilledTiles().addAll(newFilledTiles);
  }

  /**
   * <!-- begin-user-doc -->
   * <!-- end-user-doc -->
   * <!-- begin-model-doc -->
   * Uses BFS to check if a path exists from sourceCell to sinkCell
   * <!-- end-model-doc -->
   * @model
   * @generated NOT
   */
  public boolean checkPath()
  {
    if (getSourceCell() == null || getSinkCell() == null) {
      return false;
    }
    
    Set<Coordinate> visited = new HashSet<Coordinate>();
    Queue<Coordinate> queue = new LinkedList<Coordinate>();
    Pa19Helper helper = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createPa19Helper();
    
    Coordinate sourceCoord = getSourceCell().getCoord();
    visited.add(sourceCoord);
    queue.add(sourceCoord);
    
    while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
      Coordinate current = queue.poll();
      
      if (current.equals(getSinkCell().getCoord())) {
        return true;
      }
      
      int r = current.getRow();
      int c = current.getCol();
      Cell cell = getCell()[r][c];
      
      EList<Direction> directions = new BasicEList<Direction>();
      if (cell instanceof FillableCell) {
        FillableCell fc = (FillableCell) cell;
        if (fc.getPipe() != null) {
          directions.addAll(fc.getPipe().getConnections());
        }
      } else if (cell instanceof TerminationCell) {
        TerminationCell tc = (TerminationCell) cell;
        directions.add(tc.getPointingTo());
      }
      
      for (Direction dir : directions) {
        Direction opposite = helper.getOpposite(dir);
        Coordinate offset = helper.getOffset(dir);
        Coordinate neighborCoord = current.add(offset);
        
        if (!visited.contains(neighborCoord)) {
          int nr = neighborCoord.getRow();
          int nc = neighborCoord.getCol();
          if (nr >= 0 && nr < getRows() && nc >= 0 && nc < getCols()) {
            Cell neighborCell = getCell()[nr][nc];
            boolean canEnter = false;
            
            if (neighborCell instanceof FillableCell) {
              FillableCell nfc = (FillableCell) neighborCell;
              if (nfc.getPipe() != null && nfc.getPipe().getConnections().contains(opposite)) {
                canEnter = true;
              }
            } else if (neighborCell instanceof TerminationCell) {
              TerminationCell ntc = (TerminationCell) neighborCell;
              if (ntc.getPointingTo() == opposite) {
                canEnter = true;
              }
            }
            
            if (canEnter) {
              visited.add(neighborCoord);
              queue.add(neighborCoord);
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
    
    return false;
  }

  /**
   * <!-- begin-user-doc -->

   * Summary: Checks if the player has lost due to no new pipes being filled during a water update.

  public boolean hasLost()

  }

# Task
You will be given a **Requirement** and a **Class Diagram** in PlantUML. Your task is to annotate every operation listed in **Operations** with a specification.

An operation specification must describe the following sections about the operation:
1. Summary: the summary of functionality;
2. Algorithm: algorithm or pseudo code;
3. Related Features: a list of structural or behavior features within this class that shall be accessed;
4. Related Classes: a list of classes and data types defined in **Class Diagram** that shall be accessed, in the format of `Related Classes: ClsA, CLsB, ...` or `Related Classes: None`;
5. Input: the input parameters, including the meaning, the format, and the value ranges if necessary;
6. Output: output value, including the meaning, the format, and the value ranges if necessary;
7. Pre-condition: the condition that the system and the input must satisfy before the operation is executed;
8. Post-condition: the condition that the system and the output must satisfy after the operation is executed.

Finish this task by following the guidelines below.
1. Take the principle of modularization into account.
2. For each operation, determine its functional boundary based on the given requirement. Ensure high cohesion and low coupling.
3. If there is any unspecified details, such as undefined constants, rates, and ratios, then you must infer them.
4. Make sure that all requirements can be covered.

# Requirement
```text
Overall / Domain Description
This is a console pipe-connection game. The game board is a grid surrounded by outer walls. Inside the board there is one source, and on the border there is one sink. The player places pipes from a pipe queue. After an initial delay, water begins to flow through connected pipes.
The board uses zero-based internal array indices. However, index 0 and the last row/column are occupied by the outer wall border. Therefore, the playable area starts from internal index 1 and ends at rows - 2 / cols - 2.
Player-facing coordinates intentionally align with these playable internal indices:
row 1 refers to internal row 1, and column 'A' refers to internal column 1. No row-minus-one or column-minus-one conversion is applied, except that column letters are mapped so that 'A' becomes 1.
Directions include up, down, left, and right. Each direction has a corresponding opposite direction and a unit movement offset(class PA19Helper will help class Direction to provide these functions). Pipe shapes define which directions they connect to. Termination type distinguishes source and sink.

Functional Requirements

Coordinate and Direction
A coordinate stores the internal row and column used directly to access the cell grid. A cell stored at a given grid position should carry the same coordinate value.
Because the outer border occupies index 0, playable cells naturally begin at index 1. This allows user input to align directly with the playable internal grid.
Directions support movement calculations through their unit offsets and can be compared against their opposite direction when checking pipe connectivity.

Game
The game supports placing the current pipe, skipping the current pipe, undoing the latest placement, advancing the water state, checking whether the player has won, checking whether the player has lost, and tracking the number of player steps.
When the player places a pipe, the row value is used directly. The column letter is converted so that 'A' maps to column 1, 'B' maps to column 2, and so on. For example, row 1 and column 'A' target the internal cell at [1][1].
Skipping removes the current pipe from the front of the queue and counts as one step.
Undo restores the latest placed pipe to the front of the queue, clears that pipe from the board, and counts as one step. If there is no previous placement to undo, the operation fails without changing the board.

Map
The map stores cells in a two-dimensional grid with indices from [0..rows-1] and [0..cols-1]. The outermost row and column positions are walls. The playable area is [1..rows-2] by [1..cols-2].
A pipe may be placed only when all of the following are true:
1. The target coordinate is inside the playable area.
2. The target cell is a fillable cell.
3. The target cell does not already contain a pipe.

Cell Family
Cells are parsed from map characters into concrete cell types.
A fillable cell may contain a pipe or be empty. Empty fillable cells render as a dot.
A termination cell represents either the source or the sink. It stores the direction it points toward and whether it has been filled by water.
A wall cell represents the board boundary and renders using the wall character.

Termination Cell Rendering
A termination cell renders as an arrow based on its direction and filled state. Filled and unfilled arrows come from the shared rendering constants.
Both source and sink use their stored pointing direction directly. The direction is not reversed for either type.
Throws IllegalStateException("Invalid pointingTo value!") for unknown direction.

Pipe
A pipe has a shape and a filled state. Its shape determines the directions it connects to.
Supported pipe shapes include horizontal, vertical, the four corner shapes, and cross.
Pipe rendering depends on both shape and filled state. The rendered character should come from the shared rendering constants rather than hardcoded glyphs.
Short pipe codes include HZ, VT, TL, TR, BL, BR, and CR.

Water Flow
At the beginning of water flow, the source is marked as filled.
Water expands outward from the source by distance. Each update increases the reachable fill distance by one.
Water may move from one pipe to an adjacent pipe only when both sides connect to each other: the outgoing direction of one pipe must match the opposite direction of the neighboring pipe.
The filling process follows breadth-first expansion from the source.

Win and Loss Conditions
The player wins if there is a connected path from the source to the sink.
Path checking starts from the source by moving once in the source’s pointing direction. From each pipe, traversal continues through that pipe’s connection directions. The path does not require pipes to already be filled. Reaching the sink means the game is won.
The player loses when a water-flow update fills no new pipes. Loss is checked only after the initial delay has ended and water has actually started advancing.

Pipe Queue
The pipe queue stores upcoming pipes. The player always interacts with the pipe at the front.
When a pipe is consumed, the queue is automatically refilled up to a fixed maximum length using randomly generated pipe shapes.
Undo places the restored pipe back at the front of the queue.

Delay Bar
The delay bar starts with an initial value and decreases once per round.
While the value is still positive, water has not begun flowing. Once the countdown passes zero, the corresponding positive distance indicates how far water should expand from the source.

Cell Stack
The placement history records successfully placed cells in order.
Undo uses the most recent placement. The undo counter represents the number of successful undo actions, not the current size of the placement history.

External / Tool Classes
Pa19Helper is a handwritten helper and assembly class in the pa19 package. It is responsible for constructing core game objects from provided inputs, wiring together the map, pipe queue, delay bar, and placement history. It also centralizes basic parsing and direction utility behavior.
Deserializer is responsible for reading game input from a file and producing runtime game objects. It validates that the input file exists, reads the board size, delay value, map lines, and optional default pipes. If the input ends unexpectedly or an I/O error occurs, it returns no game object and logs the error.
When parsing map text, border cells are treated as sink-side termination candidates, while inner termination symbols are treated as source-side candidates.
Deserializer ignores blank lines and comment lines beginning with # when reading meaningful input.
PipePatterns is a final utility-style constant holder for all rendering characters. It contains the wall character and grouped constants for filled and unfilled arrows and pipe shapes. Rendering logic should rely on these constants instead of hardcoded characters.
StringUtils is a lightweight utility-style class for string helpers and should not be instantiated.
```

row 1 refers to internal row 1, and column 'A' refers to internal column 1. No row-minus-one or column-minus-one conversion is applied, except that column letters are mapped so that 'A' becomes 1.
Directions include up, down, left, and right. Each direction has a corresponding opposite direction and a unit movement offset(class PA19Helper will help class Direction to provide these functions). Pipe shapes define which directions they connect to. Termination type distinguishes source and sink.

Functional Requirements

Coordinate and Direction
A coordinate stores the internal row and column used directly to access the cell grid. A cell stored at a given grid position should carry the same coordinate value.
Because the outer border occupies index 0, playable cells naturally begin at index 1. This allows user input to align directly with the playable internal grid.
Directions support movement calculations through their unit offsets and can be compared against their opposite direction when checking pipe connectivity.

Game
The game supports placing the current pipe, skipping the current pipe, undoing the latest placement, advancing the water state, checking whether the player has won, checking whether the player has lost, and tracking the number of player steps.
When the player places a pipe, the row value is used directly. The column letter is converted so that 'A' maps to column 1, 'B' maps to column 2, and so on. For example, row 1 and column 'A' target the internal cell at [1][1].
Skipping removes the current pipe from the front of the queue and counts as one step.
Undo restores the latest placed pipe to the front of the queue, clears that pipe from the board, and counts as one step. If there is no previous placement to undo, the operation fails without changing the board.

Map
The map stores cells in a two-dimensional grid with indices from [0..rows-1] and [0..cols-1]. The outermost row and column positions are walls. The playable area is [1..rows-2] by [1..cols-2].
A pipe may be placed only when all of the following are true:
1. The target coordinate is inside the playable area.
2. The target cell is a fillable cell.
3. The target cell does not already contain a pipe.

Cell Family
Cells are parsed from map characters into concrete cell types.
A fillable cell may contain a pipe or be empty. Empty fillable cells render as a dot.
A termination cell represents either the source or the sink. It stores the direction it points toward and whether it has been filled by water.
A wall cell represents the board boundary and renders using the wall character.

Termination Cell Rendering
A termination cell renders as an arrow based on its direction and filled state. Filled and unfilled arrows come from the shared rendering constants.
Both source and sink use their stored pointing direction directly. The direction is not reversed for either type.
Throws IllegalStateException("Invalid pointingTo value!") for unknown direction.

Pipe
A pipe has a shape and a filled state. Its shape determines the directions it connects to.
Supported pipe shapes include horizontal, vertical, the four corner shapes, and cross.
Pipe rendering depends on both shape and filled state. The rendered character should come from the shared rendering constants rather than hardcoded glyphs.
Short pipe codes include HZ, VT, TL, TR, BL, BR, and CR.

Water Flow
At the beginning of water flow, the source is marked as filled.
Water expands outward from the source by distance. Each update increases the reachable fill distance by one.
Water may move from one pipe to an adjacent pipe only when both sides connect to each other: the outgoing direction of one pipe must match the opposite direction of the neighboring pipe.
The filling process follows breadth-first expansion from the source.

Win and Loss Conditions
The player wins if there is a connected path from the source to the sink.
Path checking starts from the source by moving once in the source’s pointing direction. From each pipe, traversal continues through that pipe’s connection directions. The path does not require pipes to already be filled. Reaching the sink means the game is won.
The player loses when a water-flow update fills no new pipes. Loss is checked only after the initial delay has ended and water has actually started advancing.

Pipe Queue
The pipe queue stores upcoming pipes. The player always interacts with the pipe at the front.
When a pipe is consumed, the queue is automatically refilled up to a fixed maximum length using randomly generated pipe shapes.
Undo places the restored pipe back at the front of the queue.

Delay Bar
The delay bar starts with an initial value and decreases once per round.
While the value is still positive, water has not begun flowing. Once the countdown passes zero, the corresponding positive distance indicates how far water should expand from the source.

Cell Stack
The placement history records successfully placed cells in order.
Undo uses the most recent placement. The undo counter represents the number of successful undo actions, not the current size of the placement history.

External / Tool Classes
Pa19Helper is a handwritten helper and assembly class in the pa19 package. It is responsible for constructing core game objects from provided inputs, wiring together the map, pipe queue, delay bar, and placement history. It also centralizes basic parsing and direction utility behavior.
Deserializer is responsible for reading game input from a file and producing runtime game objects. It validates that the input file exists, reads the board size, delay value, map lines, and optional default pipes. If the input ends unexpectedly or an I/O error occurs, it returns no game object and logs the error.
When parsing map text, border cells are treated as sink-side termination candidates, while inner termination symbols are treated as source-side candidates.
Deserializer ignores blank lines and comment lines beginning with # when reading meaningful input.
PipePatterns is a final utility-style constant holder for all rendering characters. It contains the wall character and grouped constants for filled and unfilled arrows and pipe shapes. Rendering logic should rely on these constants instead of hardcoded characters.
StringUtils is a lightweight utility-style class for string helpers and should not be instantiated.
```

# Requirement
```text
Overall / Domain Description
This is a console pipe-connection game. The game board is a grid surrounded by outer walls. Inside the board there is one source, and on the border there is one sink. The player places pipes from a pipe queue. After an initial delay, water begins to flow through connected pipes.
The board uses zero-based internal array indices. However, index 0 and the last row/column are occupied by the outer wall border. Therefore, the playable area starts from internal index 1 and ends at rows - 2 / cols - 2.
Player-facing coordinates intentionally align with these playable internal indices:
row 1 refers to internal row 1, and column 'A' refers to internal column 1. No row-minus-one or column-minus-one conversion is applied, except that column letters are mapped so that 'A' becomes 1.
Directions include up, down, left, and right. Each direction has a corresponding opposite direction and a unit movement offset(class PA19Helper will help class Direction to provide these functions). Pipe shapes define which directions they connect to. Termination type distinguishes source and sink.

Functional Requirements

Coordinate and Direction
A coordinate stores the internal row and column used directly to access the cell grid. A cell stored at a given grid position should carry the same coordinate value.
Because the outer border occupies index 0, playable cells naturally begin at index 1. This allows user input to align directly with the playable internal grid.
Directions support movement calculations through their unit offsets and can be compared against their opposite direction when checking pipe connectivity.

Game
The game supports placing the current pipe, skipping the current pipe, undoing the latest placement, advancing the water state, checking whether the player has won, checking whether the player has lost, and tracking the number of player steps.
When the player places a pipe, the row value is used directly. The column letter is converted so that 'A' maps to column 1, 'B' maps to column 2, and so on. For example, row 1 and column 'A' target the internal cell at [1][1].
Skipping removes the current pipe from the front of the queue and counts as one step.
Undo restores the latest placed pipe to the front of the queue, clears that pipe from the board, and counts as one step. If there is no previous placement to undo, the operation fails without changing the board.

Map
The map stores cells in a two-dimensional grid with indices from [0..rows-1] and [0..cols-1]. The outermost row and column positions are walls. The playable area is [1..rows-2] by [1..cols-2].
A pipe may be placed only when all of the following are true:
1. The target coordinate is inside the playable area.
2. The target cell is a fillable cell.
3. The target cell does not already contain a pipe.

Cell Family
Cells are parsed from map characters into concrete cell types.
A fillable cell may contain a pipe or be empty. Empty fillable cells render as a dot.
A termination cell represents either the source or the sink. It stores the direction it points toward and whether it has been filled by water.
A wall cell represents the board boundary and renders using the wall character.

Termination Cell Rendering
A termination cell renders as an arrow based on its direction and filled state. Filled and unfilled arrows come from the shared rendering constants.
Both source and sink use their stored pointing direction directly. The direction is not reversed for either type.
Throws IllegalStateException("Invalid pointingTo value!") for unknown direction.

Pipe
A pipe has a shape and a filled state. Its shape determines the directions it connects to.
Supported pipe shapes include horizontal, vertical, the four corner shapes, and cross.
Pipe rendering depends on both shape and filled state. The rendered character should come from the shared rendering constants rather than hardcoded glyphs.
Short pipe codes include HZ, VT, TL, TR, BL, BR, and CR.

Water Flow
At the beginning of water flow, the source is marked as filled.
Water expands outward from the source by distance. Each update increases the reachable fill distance by one.
Water may move from one pipe to an adjacent pipe only when both sides connect to each other: the outgoing direction of one pipe must match the opposite direction of the neighboring pipe.
The filling process follows breadth-first expansion from the source.

Win and Loss Conditions
The player wins if there is a connected path from the source to the sink.
Path checking starts from the source by moving once in the source’s pointing direction. From each pipe, traversal continues through that pipe’s connection directions. The path does not require pipes to already be filled. Reaching the sink means the game is won.
The player loses when a water-flow update fills no new pipes. Loss is checked only after the initial delay has ended and water has actually started advancing.

Pipe Queue
The pipe queue stores upcoming pipes. The player always interacts with the pipe at the front.
When a pipe is consumed, the queue is automatically refilled up to a fixed maximum length using randomly generated pipe shapes.
Undo places the restored pipe back at the front of the queue.

Delay Bar
The delay bar starts with an initial value and decreases once per round.
While the value is still positive, water has not begun flowing. Once the countdown passes zero, the corresponding positive distance indicates how far water should expand from the source.

Cell Stack
The placement history records successfully placed cells in order.
Undo uses the most recent placement. The undo counter represents the number of successful undo actions, not the current size of the placement history.

External / Tool Classes
Pa19Helper is a handwritten helper and assembly class in the pa19 package. It is responsible for constructing core game objects from provided inputs, wiring together the map, pipe queue, delay bar, and placement history. It also centralizes basic parsing and direction utility behavior.
Deserializer is responsible for reading game input from a file and producing runtime game objects. It validates that the input file exists, reads the board size, delay value, map lines, and optional default pipes. If the input ends unexpectedly or an I/O error occurs, it returns no game object and logs the error.
When parsing map text, border cells are treated as sink-side termination candidates, while inner termination symbols are treated as source-side candidates.
Deserializer ignores blank lines and comment lines beginning with # when reading meaningful input.
PipePatterns is a final utility-style constant holder for all rendering characters. It contains the wall character and grouped constants for filled and unfilled arrows and pipe shapes. Rendering logic should rely on these constants instead of hardcoded characters.
StringUtils is a lightweight utility-style class for string helpers and should not be instantiated.
```
