  /**
   * <!-- begin-user-doc -->
   * <!-- end-user-doc -->
   * <!-- begin-model-doc -->
   * Summary: Attempts to place the current pipe (from the front of the queue) at the specified row and column. Converts column letter to internal index (A=1, B=2, etc.). If placement succeeds, consumes the pipe from queue, increments step count, and returns true. Otherwise returns false.
   * Algorithm:
   *   1. Convert col char to internal column index: colIndex = col - 'A' + 1
   *   2. Get current pipe from pipeQueue.peek()
   *   3. If pipe is null, return false
   *   4. Call map.tryPlacePipe(row, colIndex, pipe)
   *   5. If successful:
   *      a. pipeQueue.consume()
   *      b. numOfSteps++
   *      c. Return true
   *   6. Else return false
   * Related Features: pipeQueue field, map field, numOfSteps field
   * Related Classes: PipeQueue, Map, Pipe
   * Input: row: int - playable row (1-indexed), col: char - column letter ('A'..'Z')
   * Output: boolean - true if pipe was placed successfully, false otherwise
   * Pre-condition: row >= 1, col is a letter
   * Post-condition: If successful, the pipe is placed on the map, removed from queue, and step count incremented
   * <!-- end-model-doc -->
   * @model annotation="http://www.ustb.edu.cn/sei/mde/EnhancedCodeGen generated='true'"
   * @generated NOT
   */
  public boolean placePipe(final int row, final char col)
  {
    int colIndex = col - 'A' + 1;
    Pipe pipe = getPipeQueue().peek();
    if (pipe == null)
    {
      return false;
    }
    if (getMap().tryPlacePipe(row, colIndex, pipe))
    {
      getPipeQueue().consume();
      numOfSteps++;
      return true;
    }
    return false;
  }

  /**
   * <!-- begin-user-doc -->
   * <!-- end-user-doc -->
   * <!-- begin-model-doc -->
   * Summary: Attempts to undo the most recent pipe placement. Restores the pipe to the front of the queue, clears it from the board, and counts as one step. Fails if there is no placement history.
   * Algorithm:
   *   1. Get cell from cellStack.pop()
   *   2. If cell is null, return false
   *   3. map.undo(cell.coord)
   *   4. pipeQueue.undo(cell.pipe)
   *   5. numOfSteps++
   *   6. Return true
   * Related Features: cellStack field, map field, pipeQueue field, numOfSteps field
   * Related Classes: CellStack, Map, PipeQueue, FillableCell, Pipe
   * Input: None
   * Output: boolean - true if undo was successful, false otherwise
   * Pre-condition: None
   * Post-condition: If successful, the last placed pipe is removed from board and returned to queue front, step count incremented
   * <!-- end-model-doc -->
   * @model annotation="http://www.ustb.edu.cn/sei/mde/EnhancedCodeGen generated='true'"
   * @generated NOT
   */
  public boolean undoStep()
  {
    FillableCell cell = getCellStack().pop();
    if (cell == null)
    {
      return false;
    }
    getMap().undo(cell.getCoord());
    getPipeQueue().undo(cell.getPipe());
    numOfSteps++;
    return true;
  }

public boolean tryPlacePipe(final int row, final int col, final Pipe pipe)
{
    // Validate coordinates are within playable area
    if (row < 0 || row >= rows || col < 0 || col >= cols) {
        return false;
    }
    // Get the cell at the given coordinate
    Cell targetCell = cell[row][col];
    // Check if cell is fillable
    if (!(targetCell instanceof FillableCell)) {
        return false;
    }
    FillableCell fillableCell = (FillableCell) targetCell;
    // Check if cell does not already contain a pipe
    if (fillableCell.getPipe() != null) {
        return false;
    }
    // Set the pipe
    fillableCell.setPipe(pipe);
    return true;
}

public void fillTiles(final int distance)
{
    // 1. If sourceCell not filled: fillBeginTile()
    if (getSourceCell() != null && !getSourceCell().isFilled()) {
        fillBeginTile();
    }
    
    // Collect newly filled tiles
    EList<Coordinate> newFilled = new BasicEList<Coordinate>();
    
    // 2. For each filled tile, check all four adjacent cells
    for (Coordinate filledCoord : getFilledTiles()) {
        int r = filledCoord.getRow();
        int c = filledCoord.getCol();
        Cell cellAtCoord = cell[r][c];
        
        // Determine which directions water can flow from this cell
        EList<Direction> outgoingDirections = new BasicEList<Direction>();
        
        if (cellAtCoord instanceof TerminationCell) {
            TerminationCell termCell = (TerminationCell) cellAtCoord;
            if (termCell.isFilled()) {
                outgoingDirections.add(termCell.getPointingTo());
            }
        } else if (cellAtCoord instanceof FillableCell) {
            FillableCell fillCell = (FillableCell) cellAtCoord;
            if (fillCell.getPipe() != null) {
                outgoingDirections.addAll(fillCell.getPipe().getConnections());
            }
        }
        
        // For each outgoing direction, check the adjacent cell
        for (Direction dir : outgoingDirections) {
            int nr = r, nc = c;
            switch (dir) {
                case UP: nr = r - 1; break;
                case DOWN: nr = r + 1; break;
                case LEFT: nc = c - 1; break;
                case RIGHT: nc = c + 1; break;
            }
            
            // Check bounds
            if (nr < 0 || nr >= rows || nc < 0 || nc >= cols) continue;
            
            Cell neighborCell = cell[nr][nc];
            Direction oppositeDir = getOpposite(dir);
            
            boolean canConnect = false;
            
            if (neighborCell instanceof TerminationCell) {
                TerminationCell termNeighbor = (TerminationCell) neighborCell;
                if (!termNeighbor.isFilled() && termNeighbor.getPointingTo() == oppositeDir) {
                    canConnect = true;
                }
            } else if (neighborCell instanceof FillableCell) {
                FillableCell fillNeighbor = (FillableCell) neighborCell;
                if (fillNeighbor.getPipe() != null && fillNeighbor.getPipe().getConnections().contains(oppositeDir)) {
                    canConnect = true;
                }
            }
            
            if (canConnect) {
                Coordinate neighborCoord = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createCoordinate();
                neighborCoord.setRow(nr);
                neighborCoord.setCol(nc);
                
                // Check if already filled
                boolean alreadyFilled = false;
                for (Coordinate fc : getFilledTiles()) {
                    if (fc.getRow() == nr && fc.getCol() == nc) {
                        alreadyFilled = true;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if (!alreadyFilled) {
                    // Check if already in newFilled
                    boolean alreadyInNew = false;
                    for (Coordinate nc2 : newFilled) {
                        if (nc2.getRow() == nr && nc2.getCol() == nc) {
                            alreadyInNew = true;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                    if (!alreadyInNew) {
                        newFilled.add(neighborCoord);
                        // Mark as filled
                        if (neighborCell instanceof TerminationCell) {
                            ((TerminationCell) neighborCell).setFilled(true);
                        } else if (neighborCell instanceof FillableCell && ((FillableCell) neighborCell).getPipe() != null) {
                            ((FillableCell) neighborCell).getPipe().setFilled(true);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    // 4. Add newFilled tiles to filledTiles list
    getFilledTiles().addAll(newFilled);
    
    // 5. Update prevFilledTiles count
    prevFilledTiles = getFilledTiles().size();
}

public void fillBeginTile()
{
    if (this.getSourceCell() != null) {
        this.getSourceCell().setFilled(true);
    }

private static Direction getOpposite(Direction dir) {
    switch (dir) {
        case UP: return Direction.DOWN;
        case DOWN: return Direction.UP;
        case LEFT: return Direction.RIGHT;
        case RIGHT: return Direction.LEFT;
        default: return null;
    }
}

{
    // 1. If sourceCell not filled: fillBeginTile()

        fillBeginTile();

public boolean checkPath()
{
    if (getSourceCell() == null || getSinkCell() == null) return false;
    
    Coordinate sourceCoord = getSourceCell().getCoord();
    Coordinate sinkCoord = getSinkCell().getCoord();
    
    // BFS
    java.util.Queue<Coordinate> queue = new java.util.LinkedList<Coordinate>();
    java.util.Set<Coordinate> visited = new java.util.HashSet<Coordinate>();
    
    queue.add(sourceCoord);
    visited.add(sourceCoord);
    
    Direction[] directions = {Direction.UP, Direction.DOWN, Direction.LEFT, Direction.RIGHT};
    
    while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
        Coordinate current = queue.poll();
        int r = current.getRow();
        int c = current.getCol();
        
        // Check if we reached the sink
        if (r == sinkCoord.getRow() && c == sinkCoord.getCol()) {
            return true;
        }
        
        Cell currentCell = cell[r][c];
        
        for (Direction dir : directions) {
            int nr = r, nc = c;
            switch (dir) {
                case UP: nr = r - 1; break;
                case DOWN: nr = r + 1; break;
                case LEFT: nc = c - 1; break;
                case RIGHT: nc = c + 1; break;
            }
            
            if (nr < 0 || nr >= rows || nc < 0 || nc >= cols) continue;
            
            Coordinate neighborCoord = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createCoordinate();
            neighborCoord.setRow(nr);
            neighborCoord.setCol(nc);
            
            if (visited.contains(neighborCoord)) continue;
            
            Cell neighborCell = cell[nr][nc];
            
            // Check if current has connection going this way
            boolean currentHasConnection = false;
            if (currentCell instanceof TerminationCell) {
                if (((TerminationCell) currentCell).getPointingTo() == dir) {
                    currentHasConnection = true;
                }
            } else if (currentCell instanceof FillableCell) {
                FillableCell fillCell = (FillableCell) currentCell;
                if (fillCell.getPipe() != null && fillCell.getPipe().getConnections().contains(dir)) {
                    currentHasConnection = true;
                }
            }
            
            if (!currentHasConnection) continue;
            
            // Check if neighbor has connection coming from opposite direction
            Direction oppositeDir;
            switch (dir) {
                case UP: oppositeDir = Direction.DOWN; break;
                case DOWN: oppositeDir = Direction.UP; break;
                case LEFT: oppositeDir = Direction.RIGHT; break;
                case RIGHT: oppositeDir = Direction.LEFT; break;
                default: oppositeDir = null;
            }
            
            boolean neighborHasConnection = false;
            if (neighborCell instanceof TerminationCell) {
                if (((TerminationCell) neighborCell).getPointingTo() == oppositeDir) {
                    neighborHasConnection = true;
                }
            } else if (neighborCell instanceof FillableCell) {
                FillableCell fillNeighbor = (FillableCell) neighborCell;
                if (fillNeighbor.getPipe() != null && fillNeighbor.getPipe().getConnections().contains(oppositeDir)) {
                    neighborHasConnection = true;
                }
            }
            
            if (!neighborHasConnection) continue;
            
            visited.add(neighborCoord);
            queue.add(neighborCoord);
        }
    }
    
    return false;
}

public void fillTiles(final int distance) {
    // 1. If sourceCell not filled: fillBeginTile()
    if (getSourceCell() != null && !getSourceCell().isFilled()) {
        fillBeginTile();
    }
    
    EList<Coordinate> filledTiles = getFilledTiles();
    EList<Coordinate> newFilled = new BasicEList<Coordinate>();
    
    // For each filled tile, check all four adjacent cells
    for (Coordinate filledCoord : filledTiles) {
        int r = filledCoord.getRow();
        int c = filledCoord.getCol();
        
        // Check UP
        if (r > 0) {
            tryFillNeighbor(r, c, r-1, c, Direction.UP, newFilled);
        }
        // Check DOWN
        if (r < getRows() - 1) {
            tryFillNeighbor(r, c, r+1, c, Direction.DOWN, newFilled);
        }
        // Check LEFT
        if (c > 0) {
            tryFillNeighbor(r, c, r, c-1, Direction.LEFT, newFilled);
        }
        // Check RIGHT
        if (c < getCols() - 1) {
            tryFillNeighbor(r, c, r, c+1, Direction.RIGHT, newFilled);
        }
    }
    
    // Add new filled tiles
    filledTiles.addAll(newFilled);
    
    // Update prevFilledTiles
    prevFilledTiles = filledTiles.size();
}

private void tryFillNeighbor(int r, int c, int nr, int nc, Direction dir, EList<Coordinate> newFilled) {
    Cell currentCell = getCell()[r][c];
    Cell neighborCell = getCell()[nr][nc];
    
    // Check if current cell has connection in direction dir
    boolean currentHasConnection = false;
    if (currentCell instanceof FillableCell) {
        Pipe pipe = ((FillableCell) currentCell).getPipe();
        if (pipe != null && pipe.getConnections().contains(dir)) {
            currentHasConnection = true;
        }
    }
    
    // Check if neighbor cell has a pipe that connects back
    if (currentHasConnection && neighborCell instanceof FillableCell) {
        Pipe neighborPipe = ((FillableCell) neighborCell).getPipe();
        if (neighborPipe != null) {
            Direction opposite = getOpposite(dir);
            if (neighborPipe.getConnections().contains(opposite)) {
                // Check if not already filled
                Coordinate neighborCoord = neighborCell.getCoord();
                if (!isFilled(neighborCoord)) {
                    newFilled.add(neighborCoord);
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
public boolean checkPath() {
    if (getSourceCell() == null || getSinkCell() == null) {
        return false;
    }
    
    // BFS from source to sink
    java.util.Queue<Coordinate> queue = new java.util.LinkedList<>();
    java.util.Set<Coordinate> visited = new java.util.HashSet<>();
    
    Coordinate sourceCoord = getSourceCell().getCoord();
    queue.add(sourceCoord);
    visited.add(sourceCoord);
    
    while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
        Coordinate current = queue.poll();
        
        // Check if we reached the sink
        if (current.equals(getSinkCell().getCoord())) {
            return true;
        }
        
        int r = current.getRow();
        int c = current.getCol();
        
        // Check UP
        if (r > 0) {
            tryAddNeighbor(r, c, r-1, c, Direction.UP, queue, visited);
        }
        // Check DOWN
        if (r < getRows() - 1) {
            tryAddNeighbor(r, c, r+1, c, Direction.DOWN, queue, visited);
        }
        // Check LEFT
        if (c > 0) {
            tryAddNeighbor(r, c, r, c-1, Direction.LEFT, queue, visited);
        }
        // Check RIGHT
        if (c < getCols() - 1) {
            tryAddNeighbor(r, c, r, c+1, Direction.RIGHT, queue, visited);
        }
    }
    
    return false;
}

private boolean hasConnection(Cell cell, Direction dir) {
    if (cell instanceof FillableCell) {
        Pipe pipe = ((FillableCell) cell).getPipe();
        return pipe != null && pipe.getConnections().contains(dir);
    } else if (cell instanceof TerminationCell) {
        return ((TerminationCell) cell).getPointingTo() == dir;
    }
    return false;
}

```java
   * Summary: Performs one step of water expansion. Marks source as filled if not already. Then performs breadth-first expansion from all currently filled tiles, expanding outward by one step (to the given distance limit). Tracks number of newly filled tiles for loss detection.
   * Algorithm:
   *   1. If sourceCell not filled: fillBeginTile()
   *   2. For each filled tile, check all four adjacent cells
   *   3. For each adjacent cell that contains a pipe:
   *      - Check if the two pipes connect (outgoing direction of current matches opposite direction of neighbor)
   *      - If connected and not already filled, mark as filled and add to newFilled list
   *   4. Add newFilled tiles to filledTiles list
   *   5. Update prevFilledTiles count
   * Related Features: filledTiles field, sourceCell field, sinkCell field, prevFilledTiles field
   * Related Classes: Coordinate, Pipe, Direction, TerminationCell, FillableCell
   * Input: distance: int - the current expansion distance (unused in simple implementation, but represents iteration count)
   * Output: void
   * Pre-condition: None
```

```java
   * Summary: Performs one step of water expansion. Marks source as filled if not already. Then performs breadth-first expansion from all currently filled tiles, expanding outward by one step (to the given distance limit). Tracks number of newly filled tiles for loss detection.
```

public boolean tryPlacePipe(final int row, final int col, final Pipe pipe) {
    if (row < 0 || row >= getRows() || col < 0 || col >= getCols()) {
        return false;
    }
    Cell c = getCell()[row][col];
    if (c instanceof FillableCell) {
        FillableCell fc = (FillableCell) c;
        if (fc.getPipe() == null) {
            fc.setPipe(pipe);
            return true;
        }
    }
    return false;
}
public void undo(final Coordinate coord) {
    Cell c = getCell()[coord.getRow()][coord.getCol()];
    if (c instanceof FillableCell) {
        ((FillableCell) c).setPipe(null);
    }
    getFilledTiles().remove(coord);
}
public void fillTiles(final int distance) {
    if (!getSourceCell().isFilled()) {
        fillBeginTile();
    }
    EList<Coordinate> newFilled = new BasicEList<Coordinate>();
    for (Coordinate filledCoord : getFilledTiles()) {
        int r = filledCoord.getRow();
        int c = filledCoord.getCol();
        Cell cellAt = getCell()[r][c];
        Pipe pipeAt = null;
        if (cellAt instanceof FillableCell) {
            pipeAt = ((FillableCell) cellAt).getPipe();
        }
        if (pipeAt == null) continue;
        
        // Check four adjacent cells
        // Up
        checkAndFill(r-1, c, pipeAt, Direction.UP, newFilled);
        // Down
        checkAndFill(r+1, c, pipeAt, Direction.DOWN, newFilled);
        // Left
        checkAndFill(r, c-1, pipeAt, Direction.LEFT, newFilled);
        // Right
        checkAndFill(r, c+1, pipeAt, Direction.RIGHT, newFilled);
    }
    getFilledTiles().addAll(newFilled);
    setPrevFilledTiles(getFilledTiles().size());
}
public boolean tryPlacePipe1(final Coordinate coord, final Pipe pipe) {
    return tryPlacePipe(coord.row, coord.col, pipe);
}
public void fillTiles(final int distance) {
    if (!getSourceCell().isFilled()) {
        fillBeginTile();
    }
    
    EList<Coordinate> newFilled = new BasicEList<Coordinate>();
    
    for (Coordinate filledCoord : getFilledTiles()) {
        int r = filledCoord.getRow();
        int c = filledCoord.getCol();
        Cell cellAt = getCell()[r][c];
        
        // Get the connections from the current cell
        EList<Direction> connections = null;
        if (cellAt instanceof FillableCell) {
            Pipe pipe = ((FillableCell) cellAt).getPipe();
            if (pipe != null) {
                connections = pipe.getConnections();
            }
        } else if (cellAt instanceof TerminationCell) {
            // For termination cells, the connection is the pointingTo direction
            connections = new BasicEList<Direction>();
            connections.add(((TerminationCell) cellAt).getPointingTo());
        }
        
        if (connections == null) continue;
        
        for (Direction dir : connections) {
            int nr = r, nc = c;
            switch (dir) {
                case UP: nr = r - 1; break;
                case DOWN: nr = r + 1; break;
                case LEFT: nc = c - 1; break;
                case RIGHT: nc = c + 1; break;
            }
            
            if (nr < 0 || nr >= getRows() || nc < 0 || nc >= getCols()) continue;
            
            Cell neighborCell = getCell()[nr][nc];
            if (neighborCell instanceof FillableCell) {
                Pipe neighborPipe = ((FillableCell) neighborCell).getPipe();
                if (neighborPipe == null) continue;
                
                // Check if neighbor pipe has the opposite direction
                Direction opposite = getOpposite(dir);
                if (neighborPipe.getConnections().contains(opposite)) {
                    // Check if already filled
                    Coordinate neighborCoord = findCoord(nr, nc);
                    if (neighborCoord == null) {
                        neighborCoord = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createCoordinate();
                        neighborCoord.setRow(nr);
                        neighborCoord.setCol(nc);
                        neighborPipe.setFilled(true);
                        newFilled.add(neighborCoord);
                    }
                }
            } else if (neighborCell instanceof TerminationCell) {
                // Check if the termination cell's pointingTo is opposite
                Direction opposite = getOpposite(dir);
                if (((TerminationCell) neighborCell).getPointingTo() == opposite) {
                    Coordinate neighborCoord = findCoord(nr, nc);
                    if (neighborCoord == null) {
                        neighborCoord = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createCoordinate();
                        neighborCoord.setRow(nr);
                        neighborCoord.setCol(nc);
                        ((TerminationCell) neighborCell).setFilled(true);
                        newFilled.add(neighborCoord);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    getFilledTiles().addAll(newFilled);
    setPrevFilledTiles(getFilledTiles().size());
}
public boolean checkPath() {
    // BFS from sourceCell to sinkCell
    Set<Coordinate> visited = new HashSet<Coordinate>();
    Queue<Coordinate> queue = new LinkedList<Coordinate>();
    
    Coordinate sourceCoord = getSourceCell().getCoord();
    queue.add(sourceCoord);
    visited.add(sourceCoord);
    
    while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
        Coordinate current = queue.poll();
        int r = current.getRow();
        int c = current.getCol();
        
        Cell cellAt = getCell()[r][c];
        
        // Get connections
        EList<Direction> connections = null;
        if (cellAt instanceof FillableCell) {
            Pipe pipe = ((FillableCell) cellAt).getPipe();
            if (pipe != null) {
                connections = pipe.getConnections();
            }
        } else if (cellAt instanceof TerminationCell) {
            connections = new BasicEList<Direction>();
            connections.add(((TerminationCell) cellAt).getPointingTo());
        }
        
        if (connections == null) continue;
        
        for (Direction dir : connections) {
            int nr = r, nc = c;
            switch (dir) {
                case UP: nr = r - 1; break;
                case DOWN: nr = r + 1; break;
                case LEFT: nc = c - 1; break;
                case RIGHT: nc = c + 1; break;
            }
            
            if (nr < 0 || nr >= getRows() || nc < 0 || nc >= getCols()) continue;
            
            Coordinate neighborCoord = null;
            // Find or create neighbor coordinate
            for (Coordinate fc : getFilledTiles()) {
                if (fc.getRow() == nr && fc.getCol() == nc) {
                    neighborCoord = fc;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (neighborCoord == null) {
                neighborCoord = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createCoordinate();
                neighborCoord.setRow(nr);
                neighborCoord.setCol(nc);
            }
            
            if (!visited.contains(neighborCoord)) {
                Cell neighborCell = getCell()[nr][nc];
                if (neighborCell instanceof FillableCell) {
                    Pipe neighborPipe = ((FillableCell) neighborCell).getPipe();
                    if (neighborPipe != null) {
                        Direction opposite = getOpposite(dir);
                        if (neighborPipe.getConnections().contains(opposite)) {
                            if (neighborCoord.getRow() == getSinkCell().getCoord().getRow() && 
                                neighborCoord.getCol() == getSinkCell().getCoord().getCol()) {
                                return true;
                            }
                            visited.add(neighborCoord);
                            queue.add(neighborCoord);
                        }
                    }
                } else if (neighborCell instanceof TerminationCell) {
                    Direction opposite = getOpposite(dir);
                    if (((TerminationCell) neighborCell).getPointingTo() == opposite) {
                        if (neighborCell == getSinkCell()) {
                            return true;
                        }
                        visited.add(neighborCoord);
                        queue.add(neighborCoord);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    return false;
}
public void fillTiles(final int distance) {
    if (!getSourceCell().isFilled()) {
        fillBeginTile();
    }
    
    EList<Coordinate> newFilled = new BasicEList<Coordinate>();
    
    for (Coordinate filledCoord : getFilledTiles()) {
        int r = filledCoord.getRow();
        int c = filledCoord.getCol();
        
        // Check all four adjacent cells
        int[][] dirs = {{-1, 0, Direction.UP}, {1, 0, Direction.DOWN}, {0, -1, Direction.LEFT}, {0, 1, Direction.RIGHT}};
        // Actually Direction is an enum, not int. Let me use a different approach.
    }
}
private Direction getOpposite(Direction dir) {
    switch (dir) {
        case UP: return Direction.DOWN;
        case DOWN: return Direction.UP;
        case LEFT: return Direction.RIGHT;
        case RIGHT: return Direction.LEFT;
    }

}
// Check up
if (r > 0) {

    // Check connection from current to neighbor (UP direction)

private boolean hasConnection(Cell cell, Direction dir) {
    if (cell instanceof FillableCell) {
        Pipe pipe = ((FillableCell) cell).getPipe();
        return pipe != null && pipe.getConnections().contains(dir);
    } else if (cell instanceof TerminationCell) {
        return ((TerminationCell) cell).getPointingTo() == dir;
    }
    return false;
}
public boolean hasLost() {
    return getPrevFilledTiles() == getFilledTiles().size();
}
public void undo(final Coordinate coord) {
    Cell c = getCell()[coord.getRow()][coord.getCol()];
    if (c instanceof FillableCell) {
        ((FillableCell) c).setPipe(null);
    }
    getFilledTiles().remove(coord);
}
public boolean tryPlacePipe(final int row, final int col, final Pipe pipe) {
    if (row < 0 || row >= getRows() || col < 0 || col >= getCols()) {
        return false;
    }
    Cell c = getCell()[row][col];
    if (c instanceof FillableCell) {
        FillableCell fc = (FillableCell) c;
        if (fc.getPipe() == null) {
            fc.setPipe(pipe);
            return true;
        }
    }
    return false;
}

public boolean checkPath() {
    Set<Coordinate> visited = new HashSet<Coordinate>();
    Queue<Coordinate> queue = new LinkedList<Coordinate>();
    
    Coordinate sourceCoord = getSourceCell().getCoord();
    queue.add(sourceCoord);
    visited.add(sourceCoord);
    
    while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
        Coordinate current = queue.poll();
        int r = current.getRow();
        int c = current.getCol();
        
        // If we reached the sink cell
        if (r == getSinkCell().getCoord().getRow() && c == getSinkCell().getCoord().getCol()) {
            return true;
        }
        
        Cell cellAt = getCell()[r][c];
        
        // Get the directions this cell can connect to
        EList<Direction> connections = new BasicEList<Direction>();
        if (cellAt instanceof FillableCell) {
            Pipe pipe = ((FillableCell) cellAt).getPipe();
            if (pipe != null) {
                connections.addAll(pipe.getConnections());
            }
        } else if (cellAt instanceof TerminationCell) {
            connections.add(((TerminationCell) cellAt).getPointingTo());
        }
        
        for (Direction dir : connections) {
            int nr = r, nc = c;
            if (dir == Direction.UP) nr = r - 1;
            else if (dir == Direction.DOWN) nr = r + 1;
            else if (dir == Direction.LEFT) nc = c - 1;
            else if (dir == Direction.RIGHT) nc = c + 1;
            
            if (nr < 0 || nr >= getRows() || nc < 0 || nc >= getCols()) continue;
            
            Coordinate neighborCoord = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createCoordinate();
            neighborCoord.setRow(nr);
            neighborCoord.setCol(nc);
            
            if (!visited.contains(neighborCoord)) {
                Cell neighborCell = getCell()[nr][nc];
                boolean canConnect = false;
                
                if (neighborCell instanceof FillableCell) {
                    Pipe neighborPipe = ((FillableCell) neighborCell).getPipe();
                    if (neighborPipe != null) {
                        Direction opposite = getOpposite(dir);
                        canConnect = neighborPipe.getConnections().contains(opposite);
                    }
                } else if (neighborCell instanceof TerminationCell) {
                    Direction opposite = getOpposite(dir);
                    canConnect = ((TerminationCell) neighborCell).getPointingTo() == opposite;
                }
                
                if (canConnect) {
                    visited.add(neighborCoord);
                    queue.add(neighborCoord);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    return false;
}
private Direction getOpposite(Direction dir) {
    switch (dir) {
        case UP: return Direction.DOWN;
        case DOWN: return Direction.UP;
        case LEFT: return Direction.RIGHT;
        case RIGHT: return Direction.LEFT;
    }
    return null;
}

- When possible, call getter/setter methods to access field values. Do not read/write raw fields derived from the class diagram.
- The getter of a boolean attribute `bv` looks like `isBv()`, e.g., `isIsTrue()` for `isTrue`.
- When possibe, use the creation factory for object creation.
- To create an EList instance, import and use `org.eclipse.emf.common.util.BasicEList`.

```java
  public String toString()
  {
    if (eIsProxy()) return super.toString();

    StringBuilder result = new StringBuilder(super.toString());
    result.append(" (rows: ");
    result.append(rows);
    result.append(", cols: ");
    result.append(cols);
    result.append(", prevFilledTiles: ");
    result.append(prevFilledTiles);
    result.append(", prevFilledDistance: ");
    result.append(prevFilledDistance);
    result.append(", cell: ");
    result.append(cell);
    result.append(')');
    return result.toString();
  }
```

public void fillTiles(final int distance)
{
    if (getSourceCell() != null && !getSourceCell().isFilled()) {
        fillBeginTile();
    }
    
    EList<Coordinate> newFilled = new org.eclipse.emf.common.util.BasicEList<Coordinate>();
    
    for (Coordinate filledCoord : getFilledTiles()) {
        int r = filledCoord.getRow();
        int c = filledCoord.getCol();
        Cell currentCell = cell[r][c];
        
        // Determine which directions the current cell connects to
        EList<Direction> currentDirections = new org.eclipse.emf.common.util.BasicEList<Direction>();
        if (currentCell instanceof FillableCell) {
            FillableCell fc = (FillableCell) currentCell;
            if (fc.getPipe() != null) {
                currentDirections.addAll(fc.getPipe().getConnections());
            }
        } else if (currentCell instanceof TerminationCell) {
            TerminationCell tc = (TerminationCell) currentCell;
            currentDirections.add(tc.getPointingTo());
        }
        
        for (Direction dir : currentDirections) {
            int nr = r, nc = c;
            if (dir == Direction.UP) nr--;
            else if (dir == Direction.DOWN) nr++;
            else if (dir == Direction.LEFT) nc--;
            else if (dir == Direction.RIGHT) nc++;
            
            if (nr >= 0 && nr < getRows() && nc >= 0 && nc < getCols()) {
                Cell neighborCell = cell[nr][nc];
                if (neighborCell instanceof FillableCell) {
                    FillableCell fc = (FillableCell) neighborCell;
                    if (fc.getPipe() != null && !fc.getPipe().isFilled()) {
                        // Check if neighbor pipe connects in opposite direction
                        Direction opposite = getOpposite(dir);
                        if (fc.getPipe().getConnections().contains(opposite)) {
                            fc.getPipe().setFilled(true);
                            Coordinate newCoord = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createCoordinate();
                            newCoord.setRow(nr);
                            newCoord.setCol(nc);
                            newFilled.add(newCoord);
                        }
                    }
                } else if (neighborCell instanceof TerminationCell) {
                    TerminationCell tc = (TerminationCell) neighborCell;
                    if (!tc.isFilled()) {
                        Direction opposite = getOpposite(dir);
                        if (tc.getPointingTo() == opposite) {
                            tc.setFilled(true);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    getFilledTiles().addAll(newFilled);
    prevFilledTiles = getFilledTiles().size();

public boolean checkPath()
{
    if (getSourceCell() == null || getSinkCell() == null) return false;
    
    Coordinate sourceCoord = getSourceCell().getCoord();
    Coordinate sinkCoord = getSinkCell().getCoord();
    
    // BFS
    java.util.Queue<Coordinate> queue = new java.util.LinkedList<Coordinate>();
    boolean[][] visited = new boolean[getRows()][getCols()];
    
    queue.add(sourceCoord);
    visited[sourceCoord.getRow()][sourceCoord.getCol()] = true;
    
    while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
        Coordinate current = queue.poll();
        int r = current.getRow();
        int c = current.getCol();
        
        if (r == sinkCoord.getRow() && c == sinkCoord.getCol()) {
            return true;
        }
        
        Cell currentCell = cell[r][c];
        EList<Direction> connections = new org.eclipse.emf.common.util.BasicEList<Direction>();
        
        if (currentCell instanceof FillableCell) {
            FillableCell fc = (FillableCell) currentCell;
            if (fc.getPipe() != null) {
                connections.addAll(fc.getPipe().getConnections());
            }
        } else if (currentCell instanceof TerminationCell) {
            connections.add(((TerminationCell) currentCell).getPointingTo());
        }
        
        for (Direction dir : connections) {
            int nr = r, nc = c;
            if (dir == Direction.UP) nr--;
            else if (dir == Direction.DOWN) nr++;
            else if (dir == Direction.LEFT) nc--;
            else if (dir == Direction.RIGHT) nc++;
            
            if (nr >= 0 && nr < getRows() && nc >= 0 && nc < getCols() && !visited[nr][nc]) {
                Cell neighborCell = cell[nr][nc];
                Direction opposite = getOpposite(dir);
                boolean canEnter = false;
                
                if (neighborCell instanceof FillableCell) {
                    FillableCell fc = (FillableCell) neighborCell;
                    if (fc.getPipe() != null && fc.getPipe().getConnections().contains(opposite)) {
                        canEnter = true;
                    }
                } else if (neighborCell instanceof TerminationCell) {
                    if (((TerminationCell) neighborCell).getPointingTo() == opposite) {
                        canEnter = true;
                    }
                }
                
                if (canEnter) {
                    visited[nr][nc] = true;
                    Coordinate nextCoord = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createCoordinate();
                    nextCoord.setRow(nr);
                    nextCoord.setCol(nc);
                    queue.add(nextCoord);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    return false;
}

public void fillTiles(final int distance)
{
    if (getSourceCell() != null && !getSourceCell().isFilled()) {
        fillBeginTile();
    }
    
    // Ensure source coordinate is in filledTiles
    if (getSourceCell() != null && getSourceCell().getCoord() != null) {
        if (!getFilledTiles().contains(getSourceCell().getCoord())) {
            getFilledTiles().add(getSourceCell().getCoord());
        }
    }
    
    EList<Coordinate> newFilled = new org.eclipse.emf.common.util.BasicEList<Coordinate>();
    
    for (Coordinate filledCoord : getFilledTiles()) {
        int r = filledCoord.getRow();
        int c = filledCoord.getCol();
        Cell currentCell = getCell()[r][c];
        
        EList<Direction> outgoingDirs = new org.eclipse.emf.common.util.BasicEList<Direction>();
        if (currentCell instanceof FillableCell) {
            FillableCell fc = (FillableCell) currentCell;
            if (fc.getPipe() != null) {
                outgoingDirs.addAll(fc.getPipe().getConnections());
            }
        } else if (currentCell instanceof TerminationCell) {
            TerminationCell tc = (TerminationCell) currentCell;
            if (tc.getPointingTo() != null) {
                outgoingDirs.add(tc.getPointingTo());
            }
        }
        
        for (Direction dir : outgoingDirs) {
            int nr = r, nc = c;
            Direction opposite = null;
            if (dir == Direction.UP) { nr--; opposite = Direction.DOWN; }
            else if (dir == Direction.DOWN) { nr++; opposite = Direction.UP; }
            else if (dir == Direction.LEFT) { nc--; opposite = Direction.RIGHT; }
            else if (dir == Direction.RIGHT) { nc++; opposite = Direction.LEFT; }
            
            if (nr >= 0 && nr < getRows() && nc >= 0 && nc < getCols()) {
                Cell neighborCell = getCell()[nr][nc];
                if (neighborCell instanceof FillableCell) {
                    FillableCell fc = (FillableCell) neighborCell;
                    if (fc.getPipe() != null && !fc.getPipe().isFilled()) {
                        if (fc.getPipe().getConnections().contains(opposite)) {
                            fc.getPipe().setFilled(true);
                            Coordinate newCoord = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createCoordinate();
                            newCoord.setRow(nr);
                            newCoord.setCol(nc);
                            newFilled.add(newCoord);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    getFilledTiles().addAll(newFilled);
    prevFilledTiles = getFilledTiles().size();
}

```java
   *   2. For each filled tile, check all four adjacent cells
   *   3. For each adjacent cell that contains a pipe:
   *      - Check if the two pipes connect (outgoing direction of current matches opposite direction of neighbor)
   *      - If connected and not already filled, mark as filled and add to newFilled list
   *   4. Add newFilled tiles to filledTiles list
   *   5. Update prevFilledTiles count
   * Related Features: filledTiles field, sourceCell field, sinkCell field, prevFilledTiles field
   * Related Classes: Coordinate, Pipe, Direction, TerminationCell, FillableCell
   * Input: distance: int - the current expansion distance (unused in simple implementation, but represents iteration count)
   * Output: void
   * Pre-condition: None
   * Post-condition: Water has expanded by one step from all currently filled tiles
```

```java
public boolean tryPlacePipe(final int row, final int col, final Pipe pipe) {
```
```java
    // Validate bounds
    if (row < 0 || row >= getRows() || col < 0 || col >= getCols()) {
        return false;
    }
    // Get cell
    Cell c = getCell()[row][col];
    // Check if fillable
    if (!(c instanceof FillableCell)) {
        return false;
    }
    FillableCell fillableCell = (FillableCell) c;
    // Check if already has a pipe
    if (fillableCell.getPipe() != null) {
        return false;
    }
    // Set pipe
    fillableCell.setPipe(pipe);
    return true;
}
```

```java
public boolean tryPlacePipe(final int row, final int col, final Pipe pipe) {
```
```java
    // Validate bounds
    if (row < 0 || row >= getRows() || col < 0 || col >= getCols()) {
        return false;
    }
    // Get cell
    Cell c = getCell()[row][col];
    // Check if fillable
    if (!(c instanceof FillableCell)) {
        return false;
    }
    FillableCell fillableCell = (FillableCell) c;
    // Check if already has a pipe
    if (fillableCell.getPipe() != null) {
        return false;
    }
    // Set pipe
    fillableCell.setPipe(pipe);
    return true;
}
```

```java
        if (ftCoord.getRow() == coord.getRow() && ftCoord.getCol() == coord.getCol()) {
            toRemove = ftCoord;
            break;

}
```

```java
public boolean tryPlacePipe(final int row, final int col, final Pipe pipe) {
```
```java
    // Validate bounds
    if (row < 0 || row >= getRows() || col < 0 || col >= getCols()) {
        return false;
    }
    // Get cell
    Cell c = getCell()[row][col];
    // Check if fillable
    if (!(c instanceof FillableCell)) {
        return false;
    }
    FillableCell fillableCell = (FillableCell) c;
    // Check if already has a pipe
    if (fillableCell.getPipe() != null) {
        return false;
    }
    // Set pipe
    fillableCell.setPipe(pipe);
    return true;
}
```

```java
    // 1. If sourceCell not filled: fillBeginTile()
    if (getSourceCell() != null && !getSourceCell().isFilled()) {
        fillBeginTile();
    }

        Cell currentCell = getCell()[row][col];
        
        // Check all four directions
        Direction[] directions = {Direction.UP, Direction.DOWN, Direction.LEFT, Direction.RIGHT};
        for (Direction dir : directions) {
            int newRow = row;
            int newCol = col;
            switch (dir.getValue()) {
                case Direction.UP_VALUE: newRow--; break;
                case Direction.DOWN_VALUE: newRow++; break;
                case Direction.LEFT_VALUE: newCol--; break;
                case Direction.RIGHT_VALUE: newCol++; break;
            }

            if (newRow < 0 || newRow >= getRows() || newCol < 0 || newCol >= getCols()) {
                continue;
            }

            if (neighborCell instanceof FillableCell) {
                neighborPipe = ((FillableCell) neighborCell).getPipe();
            }

            }

            boolean alreadyFilled = false;
            for (Coordinate fc : getFilledTiles()) {

                    alreadyFilled = true;
                    break;
```

```java
public boolean tryPlacePipe(final int row, final int col, final Pipe pipe) {
```
```java
    // Validate bounds
    if (row < 0 || row >= getRows() || col < 0 || col >= getCols()) {
        return false;
    }
    // Get cell
    Cell c = getCell()[row][col];
    // Check if fillable
    if (!(c instanceof FillableCell)) {
        return false;
    }
    FillableCell fillableCell = (FillableCell) c;
```

**tryPlacePipe(int row, int col, Pipe pipe):**

```java
public boolean tryPlacePipe(final int row, final int col, final Pipe pipe)
{
    // Validate bounds
    if (row < 0 || row >= getRows() || col < 0 || col >= getCols()) {
        return false;
    }
    // Get the cell at the given position
    Cell c = getCell()[row][col];
    // Check if cell is fillable
    if (!(c instanceof FillableCell)) {
        return false;
    }
    FillableCell fillableCell = (FillableCell) c;
    // Check if cell already contains a pipe
    if (fillableCell.getPipe() != null) {
        return false;
    }
    // Place the pipe
    fillableCell.setPipe(pipe);
    return true;
}
```

```java
public void undo(final Coordinate coord)
{
    // Get cell at coord
    int row = coord.getRow();
    int col = coord.getCol();
    if (row >= 0 && row < getRows() && col >= 0 && col < getCols()) {
        Cell c = getCell()[row][col];
        // If cell is FillableCell, set its pipe to null
        if (c instanceof FillableCell) {
            ((FillableCell) c).setPipe(null);
        }
    }
    // Remove coord from filledTiles if present
    EList<Coordinate> ft = getFilledTiles();
    Coordinate toRemove = null;
    for (Coordinate ftCoord : ft) {
        if (ftCoord.getRow() == coord.getRow() && ftCoord.getCol() == coord.getCol()) {
            toRemove = ftCoord;
            break;
        }
    }
    if (toRemove != null) {
        ft.remove(toRemove);
    }
}
```

**fillTiles(int distance):**

```java
public void fillTiles(final int distance)
{
    // 1. If sourceCell not filled: fillBeginTile()
    if (getSourceCell() != null && !getSourceCell().isFilled()) {
        fillBeginTile();
    }
    
    // 2 & 3. For each filled tile, check all four adjacent cells
    EList<Coordinate> newFilled = new BasicEList<Coordinate>();
    
    for (Coordinate filledCoord : getFilledTiles()) {
        int row = filledCoord.getRow();
        int col = filledCoord.getCol();
        Cell currentCell = getCell()[row][col];
        
        // Determine the outgoing directions from the current cell
        EList<Direction> outgoingDirs = new BasicEList<Direction>();
        
        if (currentCell instanceof FillableCell) {
            Pipe currentPipe = ((FillableCell) currentCell).getPipe();
            if (currentPipe != null) {
                outgoingDirs.addAll(currentPipe.getConnections());
            }
        } else if (currentCell instanceof TerminationCell) {
            outgoingDirs.add(((TerminationCell) currentCell).getPointingTo());
        }
        
        // For each outgoing direction, check the adjacent cell
        for (Direction dir : outgoingDirs) {
            int newRow = row;
            int newCol = col;
            switch (dir.getValue()) {
                case Direction.UP_VALUE:
                    newRow--;
                    break;
                case Direction.DOWN_VALUE:
                    newRow++;
                    break;
                case Direction.LEFT_VALUE:
                    newCol--;
                    break;
                case Direction.RIGHT_VALUE:
                    newCol++;
                    break;
            }
            
            // Check bounds
            if (newRow < 0 || newRow >= getRows() || newCol < 0 || newCol >= getCols()) {
                continue;
            }
            
            // Check if already filled
            boolean alreadyFilled = false;
            for (Coordinate fc : getFilledTiles()) {
                if (fc.getRow() == newRow && fc.getCol() == newCol) {
                    alreadyFilled = true;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (alreadyFilled) {
                continue;
            }
            
            // Check if also in newFilled
            for (Coordinate nc : newFilled) {
                if (nc.getRow() == newRow && nc.getCol() == newCol) {
                    alreadyFilled = true;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (alreadyFilled) {
                continue;
            }
            
            Cell neighborCell = getCell()[newRow][newCol];
            
            // Check if neighbor contains a pipe
            Pipe neighborPipe = null;
            if (neighborCell instanceof FillableCell) {
                neighborPipe = ((FillableCell) neighborCell).getPipe();
            }
            
            if (neighborPipe == null) {
                continue;
            }
            
            // Check if the two pipes connect
            // Outgoing direction of current = dir
            // Opposite direction
            Direction opposite;
            switch (dir.getValue()) {
                case Direction.UP_VALUE:
                    opposite = Direction.DOWN;
                    break;
                case Direction.DOWN_VALUE:
                    opposite = Direction.UP;
                    break;
                case Direction.LEFT_VALUE:
                    opposite = Direction.RIGHT;
                    break;
                case Direction.RIGHT_VALUE:
                    opposite = Direction.LEFT;
                    break;
                default:
                    opposite = null;
                    break;
            }
            
            boolean connected = false;
            for (Direction neighborDir : neighborPipe.getConnections()) {
                if (neighborDir == opposite) {
                    connected = true;
                    break;
                }
            }
            
            if (connected) {
                Coordinate newCoord = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createCoordinate();
                newCoord.setRow(newRow);
                newCoord.setCol(newCol);
                newFilled.add(newCoord);
            }
        }
    }
    
    // 4. Add newFilled tiles to filledTiles list
    if (!newFilled.isEmpty()) {
        getFilledTiles().addAll(newFilled);
    }
    
    // 5. Update prevFilledTiles count
    prevFilledTiles = getFilledTiles().size();
}
```

**checkPath():**

```java
public boolean checkPath()
{
    if (getSourceCell() == null || getSinkCell() == null) {
        return false;
    }
    
    // BFS from sourceCell to sinkCell
    Queue<Coordinate> queue = new LinkedList<Coordinate>();
    Set<String> visited = new HashSet<String>();
    
    Coordinate startCoord = getSourceCell().getCoord();
    queue.add(startCoord);
    visited.add(startCoord.getRow() + "," + startCoord.getCol());
    
    while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
        Coordinate current = queue.poll();
        int row = current.getRow();
        int col = current.getCol();
        
        // Check if we reached the sink cell
        if (row == getSinkCell().getCoord().getRow() && col == getSinkCell().getCoord().getCol()) {
            return true;
        }
        
        Cell currentCell = getCell()[row][col];
        
        // Determine outgoing directions
        EList<Direction> outgoingDirs = new BasicEList<Direction>();
        
        if (currentCell instanceof FillableCell) {
            Pipe currentPipe = ((FillableCell) currentCell).getPipe();
            if (currentPipe != null) {
                outgoingDirs.addAll(currentPipe.getConnections());
            } else {
                continue; // No pipe, can't go anywhere
            }
        } else if (currentCell instanceof TerminationCell) {
            outgoingDirs.add(((TerminationCell) currentCell).getPointingTo());
        } else {
            continue; // Wall or other, can't go through
        }
        
        for (Direction dir : outgoingDirs) {
            int newRow = row;
            int newCol = col;
            switch (dir.getValue()) {
                case Direction.UP_VALUE:
                    newRow--;
                    break;
                case Direction.DOWN_VALUE:
                    newRow++;
                    break;
                case Direction.LEFT_VALUE:
                    newCol--;
                    break;
                case Direction.RIGHT_VALUE:
                    newCol++;
                    break;
            }
            
            // Check bounds
            if (newRow < 0 || newRow >= getRows() || newCol < 0 || newCol >= getCols()) {
                continue;
            }
            
            String key = newRow + "," + newCol;
            if (visited.contains(key)) {
                continue;
            }
            
            Cell neighborCell = getCell()[newRow][newCol];
            
            // Check if neighbor has a pipe (or is a termination cell)
            boolean canEnter = false;
            
            if (neighborCell instanceof FillableCell) {
                Pipe neighborPipe = ((FillableCell) neighborCell).getPipe();
                if (neighborPipe != null) {
                    // Check if neighbor pipe connects back
                    Direction opposite;
                    switch (dir.getValue()) {
                        case Direction.UP_VALUE:
                            opposite = Direction.DOWN;
                            break;
                        case Direction.DOWN_VALUE:
                            opposite = Direction.UP;
                            break;
                        case Direction.LEFT_VALUE:
                            opposite = Direction.RIGHT;
                            break;
                        case Direction.RIGHT_VALUE:
                            opposite = Direction.LEFT;
                            break;
                        default:
                            opposite = null;
                            break;
                    }
                    for (Direction nd : neighborPipe.getConnections()) {
                        if (nd == opposite) {
                            canEnter = true;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                }
            } else if (neighborCell instanceof TerminationCell) {
                // Can enter termination cell if its pointingTo is opposite of dir
                Direction neighborPointing = ((TerminationCell) neighborCell).getPointingTo();
                Direction opposite;
                switch (dir.getValue()) {
                    case Direction.UP_VALUE:
                        opposite = Direction.DOWN;
                        break;
                    case Direction.DOWN_VALUE:
                        opposite = Direction.UP;
                        break;
                    case Direction.LEFT_VALUE:
                        opposite = Direction.RIGHT;
                        break;
                    case Direction.RIGHT_VALUE:
                        opposite = Direction.LEFT;
                        break;
                    default:
                        opposite = null;
                        break;
                }
                if (neighborPointing == opposite) {
                    canEnter = true;
                }
            }
            
            if (canEnter) {
                visited.add(key);
                Coordinate nextCoord = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createCoordinate();
                nextCoord.setRow(newRow);
                nextCoord.setCol(newCol);
                queue.add(nextCoord);
            }
        }
    }
    
    return false;
}
```

```java
public boolean tryPlacePipe(final int row, final int col, final Pipe pipe) {
```
```java
    // Validate bounds
    if (row < 0 || row >= getRows() || col < 0 || col >= getCols()) {
        return false;
    }
    // Get cell
    Cell c = getCell()[row][col];
    // Check if fillable
    if (!(c instanceof FillableCell)) {
        return false;
    }
    FillableCell fillableCell = (FillableCell) c;
    // Check if already has a pipe
    if (fillableCell.getPipe() != null) {
        return false;
    }
    // Set pipe
    fillableCell.setPipe(pipe);
    return true;
}
```

```java
public void fillTiles(final int distance) {
    // 1. If sourceCell not filled: fillBeginTile()
    if (getSourceCell() != null && !getSourceCell().isFilled()) {
        fillBeginTile();
    }
    
    // 2. For each filled tile, check all four adjacent cells
    EList<Coordinate> newFilled = new BasicEList<Coordinate>();
    
    for (Coordinate filledCoord : getFilledTiles()) {
        int row = filledCoord.getRow();
        int col = filledCoord.getCol();
        Cell currentCell = getCell()[row][col];
        
        // Check all four directions
        Direction[] directions = {Direction.UP, Direction.DOWN, Direction.LEFT, Direction.RIGHT};
        for (Direction dir : directions) {
            int newRow = row;
            int newCol = col;
            switch (dir.getValue()) {
                case Direction.UP_VALUE: newRow--; break;
                case Direction.DOWN_VALUE: newRow++; break;
                case Direction.LEFT_VALUE: newCol--; break;
                case Direction.RIGHT_VALUE: newCol++; break;
            }
            
            // Check bounds
            if (newRow < 0 || newRow >= getRows() || newCol < 0 || newCol >= getCols()) {
                continue;
            }
            
            Cell neighborCell = getCell()[newRow][newCol];
            
            // Check if neighbor contains a pipe
            Pipe neighborPipe = null;
            if (neighborCell instanceof FillableCell) {
                neighborPipe = ((FillableCell) neighborCell).getPipe();
            }
            
            if (neighborPipe == null) {
                continue;
            }
            
            // Check if already filled
            boolean alreadyFilled = false;
            for (Coordinate fc : getFilledTiles()) {
                if (fc.getRow() == newRow && fc.getCol() == newCol) {
                    alreadyFilled = true;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (alreadyFilled) continue;
            
            // Check if the two pipes connect
            // Get the pipe of the current cell
            Pipe currentPipe = null;
            if (currentCell instanceof FillableCell) {
                currentPipe = ((FillableCell) currentCell).getPipe();
            }
            
            if (currentPipe == null) continue;
            
            // Check if outgoing direction of current matches opposite direction of neighbor
            boolean connected = false;
            for (Direction currentDir : currentPipe.getConnections()) {
                if (currentDir == dir) {
                    // Current pipe connects in this direction
                    Direction opposite = Pa19Helper.getOpposite(dir); // Need to check how to access this
```

**tryPlacePipe(int row, int col, Pipe pipe):**

```java
public boolean tryPlacePipe(final int row, final int col, final Pipe pipe)
{
    // Validate bounds
    if (row < 0 || row >= getRows() || col < 0 || col >= getCols()) {
        return false;
    }
    // Get the cell at the given position
    Cell c = getCell()[row][col];
    // Check if cell is fillable
    if (!(c instanceof FillableCell)) {
        return false;
    }
    FillableCell fillableCell = (FillableCell) c;
    // Check if cell already contains a pipe
    if (fillableCell.getPipe() != null) {
        return false;
    }
    // Place the pipe
    fillableCell.setPipe(pipe);
    return true;
}
```

**undo(Coordinate coord):**

```java
public void undo(final Coordinate coord)
{
    // Get cell at coord
    int row = coord.getRow();
    int col = coord.getCol();
    if (row >= 0 && row < getRows() && col >= 0 && col < getCols()) {
        Cell c = getCell()[row][col];
        // If cell is FillableCell, set its pipe to null
        if (c instanceof FillableCell) {
            ((FillableCell) c).setPipe(null);
        }
    }
    // Remove coord from filledTiles if present
    EList<Coordinate> ft = getFilledTiles();
    Coordinate toRemove = null;
    for (Coordinate ftCoord : ft) {
        if (ftCoord.getRow() == coord.getRow() && ftCoord.getCol() == coord.getCol()) {
            toRemove = ftCoord;
            break;
        }
    }
    if (toRemove != null) {
        ft.remove(toRemove);
    }
}
```

**fillTiles(int distance):**

```java
public void fillTiles(final int distance)
{
    // 1. If sourceCell not filled: fillBeginTile()
    if (getSourceCell() != null && !getSourceCell().isFilled()) {
        fillBeginTile();
    }
    
    // 2 & 3. For each filled tile, check all four adjacent cells
    EList<Coordinate> newFilled = new BasicEList<Coordinate>();
    
    for (Coordinate filledCoord : getFilledTiles()) {
        int row = filledCoord.getRow();
        int col = filledCoord.getCol();
        Cell currentCell = getCell()[row][col];
        
        // Determine the outgoing directions from the current cell
        EList<Direction> outgoingDirs = new BasicEList<Direction>();
        
        if (currentCell instanceof FillableCell) {
            Pipe currentPipe = ((FillableCell) currentCell).getPipe();
            if (currentPipe != null) {
                outgoingDirs.addAll(currentPipe.getConnections());
            }
        } else if (currentCell instanceof TerminationCell) {
            outgoingDirs.add(((TerminationCell) currentCell).getPointingTo());
        }
        
        // For each outgoing direction, check the adjacent cell
        for (Direction dir : outgoingDirs) {
            int newRow = row;
            int newCol = col;
            switch (dir.getValue()) {
                case Direction.UP_VALUE:
                    newRow--;
                    break;
                case Direction.DOWN_VALUE:
                    newRow++;
                    break;
                case Direction.LEFT_VALUE:
                    newCol--;
                    break;
                case Direction.RIGHT_VALUE:
                    newCol++;
                    break;
            }
            
            // Check bounds
            if (newRow < 0 || newRow >= getRows() || newCol < 0 || newCol >= getCols()) {
                continue;
            }
            
            // Check if already filled
            boolean alreadyFilled = false;
            for (Coordinate fc : getFilledTiles()) {
                if (fc.getRow() == newRow && fc.getCol() == newCol) {
                    alreadyFilled = true;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (alreadyFilled) {
                continue;
            }
            
            // Check if also in newFilled
            for (Coordinate nc : newFilled) {
                if (nc.getRow() == newRow && nc.getCol() == newCol) {
                    alreadyFilled = true;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (alreadyFilled) {
                continue;
            }
            
            Cell neighborCell = getCell()[newRow][newCol];
            
            // Check if neighbor contains a pipe
            Pipe neighborPipe = null;
            if (neighborCell instanceof FillableCell) {
                neighborPipe = ((FillableCell) neighborCell).getPipe();
            }
            
            if (neighborPipe == null) {
                continue;
            }
            
            // Check if the two pipes connect
            // Outgoing direction of current = dir
            // Opposite direction
            Direction opposite;
            switch (dir.getValue()) {
                case Direction.UP_VALUE:
                    opposite = Direction.DOWN;
                    break;
                case Direction.DOWN_VALUE:
                    opposite = Direction.UP;
                    break;
                case Direction.LEFT_VALUE:
                    opposite = Direction.RIGHT;
                    break;
                case Direction.RIGHT_VALUE:
                    opposite = Direction.LEFT;
                    break;
                default:
                    opposite = null;
                    break;
            }
            
            boolean connected = false;
            for (Direction neighborDir : neighborPipe.getConnections()) {
                if (neighborDir == opposite) {
                    connected = true;
                    break;
                }
            }
            
            if (connected) {
                Coordinate newCoord = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createCoordinate();
                newCoord.setRow(newRow);
                newCoord.setCol(newCol);
                newFilled.add(newCoord);
            }
        }
    }
    
    // 4. Add newFilled tiles to filledTiles list
    if (!newFilled.isEmpty()) {
        getFilledTiles().addAll(newFilled);
    }
    
    // 5. Update prevFilledTiles count
    prevFilledTiles = getFilledTiles().size();
}
```

**checkPath():**

```java
public boolean checkPath()
{
    if (getSourceCell() == null || getSinkCell() == null) {
        return false;
    }
    
    // BFS from sourceCell to sinkCell
    Queue<Coordinate> queue = new LinkedList<Coordinate>();
    Set<String> visited = new HashSet<String>();
    
    Coordinate startCoord = getSourceCell().getCoord();
    queue.add(startCoord);
    visited.add(startCoord.getRow() + "," + startCoord.getCol());
    
    while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
        Coordinate current = queue.poll();
        int row = current.getRow();
        int col = current.getCol();
        
        // Check if we reached the sink cell
        if (row == getSinkCell().getCoord().getRow() && col == getSinkCell().getCoord().getCol()) {
            return true;
        }
        
        Cell currentCell = getCell()[row][col];
        
        // Determine outgoing directions
        EList<Direction> outgoingDirs = new BasicEList<Direction>();
        
        if (currentCell instanceof FillableCell) {
            Pipe currentPipe = ((FillableCell) currentCell).getPipe();
            if (currentPipe != null) {
                outgoingDirs.addAll(currentPipe.getConnections());
            } else {
                continue; // No pipe, can't go anywhere
            }
        } else if (currentCell instanceof TerminationCell) {
            outgoingDirs.add(((TerminationCell) currentCell).getPointingTo());
        } else {
            continue; // Wall or other, can't go through
        }
        
        for (Direction dir : outgoingDirs) {
            int newRow = row;
            int newCol = col;
            switch (dir.getValue()) {
                case Direction.UP_VALUE:
                    newRow--;
                    break;
                case Direction.DOWN_VALUE:
                    newRow++;
                    break;
                case Direction.LEFT_VALUE:
                    newCol--;
                    break;
                case Direction.RIGHT_VALUE:
                    newCol++;
                    break;
            }
            
            // Check bounds
            if (newRow < 0 || newRow >= getRows() || newCol < 0 || newCol >= getCols()) {
                continue;
            }
            
            String key = newRow + "," + newCol;
            if (visited.contains(key)) {
                continue;
            }
            
            Cell neighborCell = getCell()[newRow][newCol];
            
            // Check if neighbor has a pipe (or is a termination cell)
            boolean canEnter = false;
            
            if (neighborCell instanceof FillableCell) {
                Pipe neighborPipe = ((FillableCell) neighborCell).getPipe();
                if (neighborPipe != null) {
                    // Check if neighbor pipe connects back
                    Direction opposite;
                    switch (dir.getValue()) {
                        case Direction.UP_VALUE:
                            opposite = Direction.DOWN;
                            break;
                        case Direction.DOWN_VALUE:
                            opposite = Direction.UP;
                            break;
                        case Direction.LEFT_VALUE:
                            opposite = Direction.RIGHT;
                            break;
                        case Direction.RIGHT_VALUE:
                            opposite = Direction.LEFT;
                            break;
                        default:
                            opposite = null;
                            break;
                    }
                    for (Direction nd : neighborPipe.getConnections()) {
                        if (nd == opposite) {
                            canEnter = true;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                }
            } else if (neighborCell instanceof TerminationCell) {
                // Can enter termination cell if its pointingTo is opposite of dir
                Direction neighborPointing = ((TerminationCell) neighborCell).getPointingTo();
                Direction opposite;
                switch (dir.getValue()) {
                    case Direction.UP_VALUE:
                        opposite = Direction.DOWN;
                        break;
                    case Direction.DOWN_VALUE:
                        opposite = Direction.UP;
                        break;
                    case Direction.LEFT_VALUE:
                        opposite = Direction.RIGHT;
                        break;
                    case Direction.RIGHT_VALUE:
                        opposite = Direction.LEFT;
                        break;
                    default:
                        opposite = null;
                        break;
                }
                if (neighborPointing == opposite) {
                    canEnter = true;
                }
            }
            
            if (canEnter) {
                visited.add(key);
                Coordinate nextCoord = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createCoordinate();
                nextCoord.setRow(newRow);
                nextCoord.setCol(newCol);
                queue.add(nextCoord);
            }
        }
    }
    
    return false;
}
```

```java
public boolean tryPlacePipe(final int row, final int col, final Pipe pipe) {
    // Validate bounds
    if (row < 0 || row >= getRows() || col < 0 || col >= getCols()) {
        return false;
    }
```
```java
    // Get cell
    Cell c = getCell()[row][col];
    // Check if fillable
    if (!(c instanceof FillableCell)) {
        return false;
    }
    FillableCell fillableCell = (FillableCell) c;
    // Check if already has a pipe
    if (fillableCell.getPipe() != null) {
        return false;
    }
    // Set pipe
    fillableCell.setPipe(pipe);
    return true;
}
```

```java
public boolean tryPlacePipe(final int row, final int col, final Pipe pipe)
{
    // Validate bounds
    if (row < 0 || row >= getRows() || col < 0 || col >= getCols()) {
        return false;
    }
    // Get the cell at the given position
    Cell c = getCell()[row][col];
    // Check if cell is fillable
    if (!(c instanceof FillableCell)) {
        return false;
    }
    FillableCell fillableCell = (FillableCell) c;
    // Check if cell already contains a pipe
    if (fillableCell.getPipe() != null) {
        return false;
    }
    // Place the pipe
    fillableCell.setPipe(pipe);
    return true;
}
```

```java
public void undo(final Coordinate coord)
{
    // Get cell at coord
    int row = coord.getRow();
    int col = coord.getCol();
    if (row >= 0 && row < getRows() && col >= 0 && col < getCols()) {
        Cell c = getCell()[row][col];
        // If cell is FillableCell, set its pipe to null
        if (c instanceof FillableCell) {
            ((FillableCell) c).setPipe(null);
        }
    }
    // Remove coord from filledTiles if present
    EList<Coordinate> ft = getFilledTiles();
    Coordinate toRemove = null;
    for (Coordinate ftCoord : ft) {
        if (ftCoord.getRow() == coord.getRow() && ftCoord.getCol() == coord.getCol()) {
            toRemove = ftCoord;
            break;
        }
    }
    if (toRemove != null) {
        ft.remove(toRemove);
    }
}
```

**fillTiles(int distance):**

```java
public void fillTiles(final int distance)
{
    // 1. If sourceCell not filled: fillBeginTile()
    if (getSourceCell() != null && !getSourceCell().isFilled()) {
        fillBeginTile();
    }
    
    // 2 & 3. For each filled tile, check all four adjacent cells
    EList<Coordinate> newFilled = new BasicEList<Coordinate>();
    
    for (Coordinate filledCoord : getFilledTiles()) {
        int row = filledCoord.getRow();
        int col = filledCoord.getCol();
        Cell currentCell = getCell()[row][col];
        
        // Determine the outgoing directions from the current cell
        EList<Direction> outgoingDirs = new BasicEList<Direction>();
        
        if (currentCell instanceof FillableCell) {
            Pipe currentPipe = ((FillableCell) currentCell).getPipe();
            if (currentPipe != null) {
                outgoingDirs.addAll(currentPipe.getConnections());
            }
        } else if (currentCell instanceof TerminationCell) {
            outgoingDirs.add(((TerminationCell) currentCell).getPointingTo());
        }
        
        // For each outgoing direction, check the adjacent cell
        for (Direction dir : outgoingDirs) {
            int newRow = row;
            int newCol = col;
            switch (dir.getValue()) {
                case Direction.UP_VALUE:
                    newRow--;
                    break;
                case Direction.DOWN_VALUE:
                    newRow++;
                    break;
                case Direction.LEFT_VALUE:
                    newCol--;
                    break;
                case Direction.RIGHT_VALUE:
                    newCol++;
                    break;
            }
            
            // Check bounds
            if (newRow < 0 || newRow >= getRows() || newCol < 0 || newCol >= getCols()) {
                continue;
            }
            
            // Check if already filled
            boolean alreadyFilled = false;
            for (Coordinate fc : getFilledTiles()) {
                if (fc.getRow() == newRow && fc.getCol() == newCol) {
                    alreadyFilled = true;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (alreadyFilled) {
                continue;
            }
            
            // Check if also in newFilled
            for (Coordinate nc : newFilled) {
                if (nc.getRow() == newRow && nc.getCol() == newCol) {
                    alreadyFilled = true;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (alreadyFilled) {
                continue;
            }
            
            Cell neighborCell = getCell()[newRow][newCol];
            
            // Check if neighbor contains a pipe
            Pipe neighborPipe = null;
            if (neighborCell instanceof FillableCell) {
                neighborPipe = ((FillableCell) neighborCell).getPipe();
            }
            
            if (neighborPipe == null) {
                continue;
            }
            
            // Check if the two pipes connect
            // Outgoing direction of current = dir
            // Opposite direction
            Direction opposite;
            switch (dir.getValue()) {
                case Direction.UP_VALUE:
                    opposite = Direction.DOWN;
                    break;
                case Direction.DOWN_VALUE:
                    opposite = Direction.UP;
                    break;
                case Direction.LEFT_VALUE:
                    opposite = Direction.RIGHT;
                    break;
                case Direction.RIGHT_VALUE:
                    opposite = Direction.LEFT;
                    break;
                default:
                    opposite = null;
                    break;
            }
            
            boolean connected = false;
            for (Direction neighborDir : neighborPipe.getConnections()) {
                if (neighborDir == opposite) {
                    connected = true;
                    break;
                }
            }
            
            if (connected) {
                Coordinate newCoord = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createCoordinate();
                newCoord.setRow(newRow);
                newCoord.setCol(newCol);
                newFilled.add(newCoord);
            }
        }
    }
    
    // 4. Add newFilled tiles to filledTiles list
    if (!newFilled.isEmpty()) {
        getFilledTiles().addAll(newFilled);
    }
    
    // 5. Update prevFilledTiles count
    prevFilledTiles = getFilledTiles().size();
}
```
