public void fillTiles(final int distance) {
    if (distance == 1) {
        fillBeginTile();
    }
    
    // BFS from source
    TerminationCell source = getSourceCell();
    if (source == null) return;
    
    Coordinate sourceCoord = source.getCoord();
    int sourceRow = sourceCoord.getRow();
    int sourceCol = sourceCoord.getCol();
    
    // Track visited coordinates
    java.util.Set<Coordinate> visited = new java.util.HashSet<>();
    java.util.LinkedList<Coordinate> queue = new java.util.LinkedList<>();
    java.util.Map<Coordinate, Integer> distMap = new java.util.HashMap<>();
    
    visited.add(sourceCoord);
    queue.add(sourceCoord);
    distMap.put(sourceCoord, 0);
    
    // Get filledTiles list
    EList<Coordinate> filledTilesList = getFilledTiles();
    
    while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
        Coordinate current = queue.poll();
        int currentDist = distMap.get(current);
        
        if (currentDist >= distance) continue;
        
        int r = current.getRow();
        int c = current.getCol();
        
        Cell currentCell = cell[r][c];
        
        // Get directions to explore
        java.util.List<Direction> dirsToExplore = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        
        if (currentCell instanceof TerminationCell) {
            TerminationCell tc = (TerminationCell) currentCell;
            if (tc.getPointingTo() != null) {
                dirsToExplore.add(tc.getPointingTo());
            }
        } else if (currentCell instanceof FillableCell) {
            FillableCell fc = (FillableCell) currentCell;
            if (fc.getPipe() != null) {
                dirsToExplore.addAll(fc.getPipe().getConnections());
            }
        }
        
        for (Direction dir : dirsToExplore) {
            int nr = r, nc = c;
            switch (dir) {
                case UP: nr = r - 1; break;
                case DOWN: nr = r + 1; break;
                case LEFT: nc = c - 1; break;
                case RIGHT: nc = c + 1; break;
            }
            
            // Check bounds
            if (nr < 0 || nr >= rows || nc < 0 || nc >= cols) continue;
            
            Cell neighborCell = cell[nr][nc];
            if (neighborCell instanceof FillableCell) {
                FillableCell nfc = (FillableCell) neighborCell;
                if (nfc.getPipe() != null) {
                    Direction oppositeDir = getOpposite(dir);
                    if (nfc.getPipe().getConnections().contains(oppositeDir)) {
                        Coordinate neighborCoord = neighborCell.getCoord();
                        if (!visited.contains(neighborCoord)) {
                            visited.add(neighborCoord);
                            queue.add(neighborCoord);
                            distMap.put(neighborCoord, currentDist + 1);
                            
                            // Mark pipe as filled
                            nfc.getPipe().setFilled(true);
                            
                            // Add to filledTiles if not already there
                            if (!filledTilesList.contains(neighborCoord)) {
                                filledTilesList.add(neighborCoord);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    // Update prevFilledDistance and prevFilledTiles
    prevFilledDistance = distance;
    prevFilledTiles = filledTilesList.size();
}
public void fillTiles(final int distance) {
    if (distance == 1) {
        fillBeginTile();
    }
    
    TerminationCell source = getSourceCell();
    if (source == null) return;
    
    // Record prev filled tiles count before this operation
    int prevCount = getFilledTiles().size();
    
    // BFS
    java.util.Set<Coordinate> visited = new java.util.HashSet<>();
    java.util.LinkedList<Coordinate> queue = new java.util.LinkedList<>();
    java.util.Map<Coordinate, Integer> distMap = new java.util.HashMap<>();
    
    Coordinate sourceCoord = source.getCoord();
    visited.add(sourceCoord);
    queue.add(sourceCoord);
    distMap.put(sourceCoord, 0);
    
    EList<Coordinate> filledTilesList = getFilledTiles();
    
    while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
        Coordinate current = queue.poll();
        int currentDist = distMap.get(current);
        
        if (currentDist >= distance) continue;
        
        int r = current.getRow();
        int c = current.getCol();
        
        if (r < 0 || r >= rows || c < 0 || c >= cols) continue;
        
        Cell currentCell = cell[r][c];
        if (currentCell == null) continue;
        
        java.util.List<Direction> directions = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        
        if (currentCell instanceof TerminationCell) {
            TerminationCell tc = (TerminationCell) currentCell;
            if (tc.getPointingTo() != null) {
                directions.add(tc.getPointingTo());
            }
        } else if (currentCell instanceof FillableCell) {
            FillableCell fc = (FillableCell) currentCell;
            if (fc.getPipe() != null) {
                directions.addAll(fc.getPipe().getConnections());
            }
        }
        
        for (Direction dir : directions) {
            int nr = r, nc = c;
            switch (dir) {
                case UP: nr = r - 1; break;
                case DOWN: nr = r + 1; break;
                case LEFT: nc = c - 1; break;
                case RIGHT: nc = c + 1; break;
            }
            
            if (nr < 0 || nr >= rows || nc < 0 || nc >= cols) continue;
            
            Cell neighborCell = cell[nr][nc];
            if (neighborCell == null) continue;
            
            Coordinate neighborCoord = neighborCell.getCoord();
            if (visited.contains(neighborCoord)) continue;
            
            boolean connected = false;
            Direction oppositeDir = opposite(dir);
            
            if (neighborCell instanceof FillableCell) {
                FillableCell nfc = (FillableCell) neighborCell;
                if (nfc.getPipe() != null && nfc.getPipe().getConnections().contains(oppositeDir)) {
                    connected = true;
                }
            } else if (neighborCell instanceof TerminationCell) {
                TerminationCell ntc = (TerminationCell) neighborCell;
                if (ntc.getPointingTo() != null && ntc.getPointingTo() == oppositeDir) {
                    connected = true;
                }
            }
            
            if (connected) {
                visited.add(neighborCoord);
                queue.add(neighborCoord);
                distMap.put(neighborCoord, currentDist + 1);
                
                if (neighborCell instanceof FillableCell) {
                    FillableCell nfc = (FillableCell) neighborCell;
                    if (nfc.getPipe() != null) {
                        nfc.getPipe().setFilled(true);
                        if (!filledTilesList.contains(neighborCoord)) {
                            filledTilesList.add(neighborCoord);
                        }
                    }
                } else if (neighborCell instanceof TerminationCell) {
                    TerminationCell ntc = (TerminationCell) neighborCell;
                    ntc.setFilled(true);
                    if (!filledTilesList.contains(neighborCoord)) {
                        filledTilesList.add(neighborCoord);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    prevFilledTiles = prevCount;
    prevFilledDistance = distance;
}
public boolean checkPath() {
    TerminationCell source = getSourceCell();
    TerminationCell sink = getSinkCell();
    if (source == null || sink == null) return false;
    
    Coordinate sourceCoord = source.getCoord();
    Coordinate sinkCoord = sink.getCoord();
    
    java.util.Set<Coordinate> visited = new java.util.HashSet<>();
    java.util.LinkedList<Coordinate> queue = new java.util.LinkedList<>();
    
    visited.add(sourceCoord);
    queue.add(sourceCoord);
    
    while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
        Coordinate current = queue.poll();
        
        if (current.equals(sinkCoord)) return true;
        
        int r = current.getRow();
        int c = current.getCol();
        
        if (r < 0 || r >= rows || c < 0 || c >= cols) continue;
        
        Cell currentCell = getCell()[r][c];
        if (currentCell == null) continue;
        
        java.util.List<Direction> directions = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        
        if (currentCell instanceof TerminationCell) {
            TerminationCell tc = (TerminationCell) currentCell;
            if (tc.getPointingTo() != null) {
                directions.add(tc.getPointingTo());
            }
        } else if (currentCell instanceof FillableCell) {
            FillableCell fc = (FillableCell) currentCell;
            if (fc.getPipe() != null) {
                directions.addAll(fc.getPipe().getConnections());
            }
        }
        
        for (Direction dir : directions) {
            int nr = r, nc = c;
            switch (dir) {
                case UP: nr = r - 1; break;
                case DOWN: nr = r + 1; break;
                case LEFT: nc = c - 1; break;
                case RIGHT: nc = c + 1; break;
            }
            
            if (nr < 0 || nr >= rows || nc < 0 || nc >= cols) continue;
            
            Cell neighborCell = getCell()[nr][nc];
            if (neighborCell == null) continue;
            
            Coordinate neighborCoord = neighborCell.getCoord();
            if (visited.contains(neighborCoord)) continue;
            
            Direction oppositeDir = opposite(dir);
            boolean connected = false;
            
            if (neighborCell instanceof FillableCell) {
                FillableCell nfc = (FillableCell) neighborCell;
                if (nfc.getPipe() != null && nfc.getPipe().getConnections().contains(oppositeDir)) {
                    connected = true;
                }
            } else if (neighborCell instanceof TerminationCell) {
                TerminationCell ntc = (TerminationCell) neighborCell;
                if (ntc.getPointingTo() != null && ntc.getPointingTo() == oppositeDir) {
                    connected = true;
                }
            }
            
            if (connected) {
                visited.add(neighborCoord);
                queue.add(neighborCoord);
            }
        }
    }
    
    return false;
}

```java
   * Algorithm:
   *   1. If this is the first fill (distance == 1), call fillBeginTile() to mark source as filled
   *   2. Perform BFS from the source, expanding outward by distance steps
   *   3. For each adjacent pipe, check if both sides connect (outgoing direction of one pipe matches the opposite direction of the neighboring pipe)

   *   7. Update prevFilledTiles to the number of filled tiles before this fill operation
   * Related Features: sourceCell, filledTiles, prevFilledDistance, prevFilledTiles
   * Related Classes: TerminationCell, Pipe, Coordinate, Direction
   * Input: distance : int - the current water expansion distance (positive integer)

    result.append(rows);
    result.append(", cols: ");
    result.append(cols);
    result.append(", prevFilledTiles: ");
    result.append(prevFilledTiles);
    result.append(", prevFilledDistance: ");
    result.append(prevFilledDistance);
    result.append(", cell: ");
    result.append(cell);
    result.append(')');
    return result.toString();
  }

} // Map
```

```java
 * Summary: Attempts to place a pipe at the specified coordinate on the map.
 * Algorithm:
 *   1. Check if coordinate is within playable area (1..rows-2, 1..cols-2)
 *   2. Check if the cell at that coordinate is a FillableCell
 *   3. Check if the cell does not already contain a pipe
 *   4. If all conditions met, set the cell's pipe to the given pipe and return true
```

```java
public boolean tryPlacePipe(final int row, final int col, final Pipe pipe)
{
    // 1. Check if coordinate is within playable area
    if (row < 1 || row > getRows() - 2 || col < 1 || col > getCols() - 2) {
        return false;
    }
    // 2. Check if the cell at that coordinate is a FillableCell
    Cell targetCell = getCell()[row][col];
    if (!(targetCell instanceof FillableCell)) {
        return false;
    }
    FillableCell fillableCell = (FillableCell) targetCell;
    // 3. Check if the cell does not already contain a pipe
    if (fillableCell.getPipe() != null) {
        return false;
    }
    // 4. Set the cell's pipe to the given pipe and return true
    fillableCell.setPipe(pipe);
    return true;
}
```

- "Perform BFS from the source, expanding outward by distance steps"
- "For each adjacent pipe, check if both sides connect"

Let me think about what "distance steps" means. The source is at some coordinate. At distance 1, we can reach adjacent cells. At distance 2, we can reach cells two steps away, etc.

For the BFS:
- Start from source cell coordinate
- Use a queue
- For each cell popped from queue, check its 4 neighbors
- If neighbor has a pipe, check if the connection from current cell matches the connection from neighbor
- If matched and not yet visited, mark as filled and add to queue

- From the source (TerminationCell), it points in direction D. So the adjacent cell in direction D should have a pipe that connects in the opposite direction (opposite of D).
- For a FillableCell with a pipe, the pipe has connections (EList<Direction>). A connection from current position to neighbor in direction D means the pipe has D in its connections list.
- For the neighbor to connect back, its pipe should have opposite(D) in its connections list.

```java
 * Summary: Attempts to place a pipe at the specified coordinate on the map.
 * Algorithm:
 *   1. Check if coordinate is within playable area (1..rows-2, 1..cols-2)
 *   2. Check if the cell at that coordinate is a FillableCell
 *   3. Check if the cell does not already contain a pipe
 *   4. If all conditions met, set the cell's pipe to the given pipe and return true
 *   5. Otherwise return false
```

```java
public boolean tryPlacePipe(final int row, final int col, final Pipe pipe)
{
    // 1. Check if coordinate is within playable area
    if (row < 1 || row > getRows() - 2 || col < 1 || col > getCols() - 2) {
        return false;
    }
    // 2. Check if the cell at that coordinate is a FillableCell
    Cell targetCell = getCell()[row][col];
    if (!(targetCell instanceof FillableCell)) {
        return false;
    }
    FillableCell fillableCell = (FillableCell) targetCell;
    // 3. Check if the cell does not already contain a pipe
    if (fillableCell.getPipe() != null) {
        return false;
    }
    // 4. Set the cell's pipe to the given pipe and return true
    fillableCell.setPipe(pipe);
    return true;
}
```

```java
public void fillTiles(final int distance) {
    // Step 1: If first fill, mark source as filled
    if (distance == 1) {
        fillBeginTile();
    }
    
    // Save current filled tiles count before this operation
    setPrevFilledTiles(getFilledTiles().size());
    
    // Get helper for utility methods
    Pa19Helper helper = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createPa19Helper();
    
    // BFS setup
    Set<Coordinate> visited = new java.util.HashSet<Coordinate>();
    java.util.Queue<Coordinate> queue = new java.util.LinkedList<Coordinate>();
    
    // Start from source cell
    TerminationCell source = getSourceCell();
    Coordinate sourceCoord = source.getCoord();
    visited.add(sourceCoord);
    queue.add(sourceCoord);
    
    // BFS
    while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
        Coordinate current = queue.poll();
        Cell currentCell = getCell()[current.getRow()][current.getCol()];
        
        // Get the directions we can go from this cell
        EList<Direction> outgoingDirs = new org.eclipse.emf.common.util.BasicEList<Direction>();
        
        if (currentCell instanceof TerminationCell) {
            TerminationCell tc = (TerminationCell) currentCell;
            outgoingDirs.add(tc.getPointingTo());
        } else if (currentCell instanceof FillableCell) {
            FillableCell fc = (FillableCell) currentCell;
            if (fc.getPipe() != null) {
                outgoingDirs.addAll(fc.getPipe().getConnections());
            }
        }
        
        // For each outgoing direction
        for (Direction dir : outgoingDirs) {
            Coordinate offset = helper.getOffset(dir);
            Coordinate neighborCoord = current.add(offset);
            
            int nr = neighborCoord.getRow();
            int nc = neighborCoord.getCol();
            
            // Check bounds
            if (nr < 0 || nr >= getRows() || nc < 0 || nc >= getCols()) {
                continue;
            }
            
            if (visited.contains(neighborCoord)) {
                continue;
            }
            
            Cell neighborCell = getCell()[nr][nc];
            
            // Check if neighbor can connect back
            boolean canConnect = false;
            Direction opposite = helper.getOpposite(dir);
            
            if (neighborCell instanceof TerminationCell) {
                TerminationCell ntc = (TerminationCell) neighborCell;
                if (ntc.getPointingTo() == opposite) {
                    canConnect = true;
                }
            } else if (neighborCell instanceof FillableCell) {
                FillableCell nfc = (FillableCell) neighborCell;
                if (nfc.getPipe() != null && nfc.getPipe().getConnections().contains(opposite)) {
                    canConnect = true;
                }
            }
            
            if (canConnect) {
                visited.add(neighborCoord);
                queue.add(neighborCoord);
                
                // Mark as filled if FillableCell
                if (neighborCell instanceof FillableCell) {
                    FillableCell nfc = (FillableCell) neighborCell;
                    if (nfc.getPipe() != null) {
                        nfc.getPipe().setFilled(true);
                    }
                } else if (neighborCell instanceof TerminationCell) {
                    ((TerminationCell) neighborCell).setFilled(true);
                }
                
                // Add to filledTiles if not already there
                if (!getFilledTiles().contains(neighborCoord)) {
                    getFilledTiles().add(neighborCoord);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    // Update prevFilledDistance
    setPrevFilledDistance(distance);
```

```java
public void fillTiles(final int distance) {
    // Step 1: If first fill, mark source as filled
    if (distance == 1) {
        fillBeginTile();
    }
    
    // Save current filled tiles count before this operation
    setPrevFilledTiles(getFilledTiles().size());
    
    Pa19Helper helper = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createPa19Helper();
    
    // BFS: level-by-level
    Set<Coordinate> visited = new java.util.HashSet<Coordinate>();
    java.util.Queue<Coordinate> queue = new java.util.LinkedList<Coordinate>();
    
    // Start from source
    TerminationCell source = getSourceCell();
    Coordinate sourceCoord = source.getCoord();
    visited.add(sourceCoord);
    queue.add(sourceCoord);
    
    int currentDistance = 0;
    
    while (!queue.isEmpty() && currentDistance < distance) {
        int levelSize = queue.size();
        currentDistance++;
        
        for (int i = 0; i < levelSize; i++) {
            Coordinate current = queue.poll();
            Cell currentCell = getCell()[current.getRow()][current.getCol()];
            
            // Get outgoing directions from current cell
            EList<Direction> outgoingDirs = new org.eclipse.emf.common.util.BasicEList<Direction>();
            
            if (currentCell instanceof TerminationCell) {
                outgoingDirs.add(((TerminationCell) currentCell).getPointingTo());
            } else if (currentCell instanceof FillableCell) {
                FillableCell fc = (FillableCell) currentCell;
                if (fc.getPipe() != null) {
                    outgoingDirs.addAll(fc.getPipe().getConnections());
                }
            }
            
            for (Direction dir : outgoingDirs) {
                Coordinate offset = helper.getOffset(dir);
                Coordinate neighborCoord = current.add(offset);
                
                int nr = neighborCoord.getRow();
                int nc = neighborCoord.getCol();
                
                if (nr < 0 || nr >= getRows() || nc < 0 || nc >= getCols()) {
                    continue;
                }
                
                if (visited.contains(neighborCoord)) {
                    continue;
                }
                
                Cell neighborCell = getCell()[nr][nc];
                Direction opposite = helper.getOpposite(dir);
                
                boolean canConnect = false;
                if (neighborCell instanceof TerminationCell) {
                    if (((TerminationCell) neighborCell).getPointingTo() == opposite) {
                        canConnect = true;
                    }
                } else if (neighborCell instanceof FillableCell) {
                    FillableCell nfc = (FillableCell) neighborCell;
                    if (nfc.getPipe() != null && nfc.getPipe().getConnections().contains(opposite)) {
                        canConnect = true;
                    }
                }
                
                if (canConnect) {
                    visited.add(neighborCoord);
                    queue.add(neighborCoord);
                    
                    // Mark as filled
                    if (neighborCell instanceof FillableCell) {
                        FillableCell nfc = (FillableCell) neighborCell;
                        if (nfc.getPipe() != null) {
                            nfc.getPipe().setFilled(true);
                        }
                    } else if (neighborCell instanceof TerminationCell) {
                        ((TerminationCell) neighborCell).setFilled(true);
                    }
                    
                    // Add to filledTiles if not already there
                    if (!getFilledTiles().contains(neighborCoord)) {
                        getFilledTiles().add(neighborCoord);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    setPrevFilledDistance(distance);
}
```

```java
    if (!getFilledTiles().contains(sourceCoord)) {
        getFilledTiles().add(sourceCoord);
    }
    
    int currentLevel = 0;
    
    while (!queue.isEmpty() && currentLevel < distance) {
        int levelSize = queue.size();
        currentLevel++;
        
        for (int i = 0; i < levelSize; i++) {
            Coordinate current = queue.poll();
            Cell currentCell = getCell()[current.getRow()][current.getCol()];
            
            // Get outgoing directions
            EList<Direction> outgoingDirs = new BasicEList<Direction>();
            
            if (currentCell instanceof TerminationCell) {
                outgoingDirs.add(((TerminationCell) currentCell).getPointingTo());
            } else if (currentCell instanceof FillableCell) {
                FillableCell fc = (FillableCell) currentCell;
                if (fc.getPipe() != null) {
                    outgoingDirs.addAll(fc.getPipe().getConnections());
                }
            }
            
            for (Direction dir : outgoingDirs) {
                Coordinate offset = helper.getOffset(dir);
                Coordinate neighborCoord = current.add(offset);
                
                int nr = neighborCoord.getRow();
                int nc = neighborCoord.getCol();
                
                if (nr < 0 || nr >= getRows() || nc < 0 || nc >= getCols()) {
                    continue;
                }
                
                if (visited.contains(neighborCoord)) {
                    continue;
                }
                
                Cell neighborCell = getCell()[nr][nc];
                Direction opposite = helper.getOpposite(dir);
                
                boolean canConnect = false;
                if (neighborCell instanceof TerminationCell) {
                    if (((TerminationCell) neighborCell).getPointingTo() == opposite) {
                        canConnect = true;
                    }
                } else if (neighborCell instanceof FillableCell) {
                    FillableCell nfc = (FillableCell) neighborCell;
                    if (nfc.getPipe() != null && nfc.getPipe().getConnections().contains(opposite)) {
                        canConnect = true;
                    }
                }
                
                if (canConnect) {
                    visited.add(neighborCoord);
                    queue.add(neighborCoord);
                    
                    // Mark as filled
                    if (neighborCell instanceof FillableCell) {
                        FillableCell nfc = (FillableCell) neighborCell;
                        if (nfc.getPipe() != null) {
                            nfc.getPipe().setFilled(true);
                        }
                    } else if (neighborCell instanceof TerminationCell) {
                        ((TerminationCell) neighborCell).setFilled(true);
                    }
                    
                    // Add to filledTiles
                    if (!getFilledTiles().contains(neighborCoord)) {
                        getFilledTiles().add(neighborCoord);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    setPrevFilledDistance(distance);
}
```

"2. Perform BFS from the source, expanding outward by distance steps"

I think "distance steps" means we expand by exactly `distance` steps from the source. So:
- Level 0: source
- Level 1: cells directly connected to source
- Level 2: cells connected to level 1 cells
- ...
- Level `distance`: cells at distance `distance` from source

So the BFS should go up to `distance` levels (inclusive). Let me adjust.

Actually, looking at the algorithm again:
"1. If this is the first fill (distance == 1), call fillBeginTile() to mark source as filled"

This suggests that for distance=1, we mark source as filled and then expand 1 step. So the BFS expands by `distance` steps from the source.

Let me keep my implementation as is but make sure the level counting is right. The source is at level 0. We expand to level 1, level 2, ..., level `distance`. So `currentLevel` starts at 0 and goes up to `distance`.

In my code, `currentLevel` starts at 0, and the while loop condition is `currentLevel < distance`. So:
- When distance=1: we process level 0 (source), expand to level 1. currentLevel becomes 1, loop exits.
- When distance=2: we process level 0, expand to level 1. currentLevel becomes 1. Then process level 1, expand to level 2. currentLevel becomes 2, loop exits.

This seems correct!

But wait, I need to reconsider. When we expand from level 0 (source), we find cells at level 1 and add them to the queue. Then we process level 1 cells and expand to level 2. This is correct.

However, in my code, I'm adding the source to the queue and then processing it. The source is at level 0. When I process the source, I expand to its neighbors (level 1). Then the next iteration processes level 1 cells, expanding to level 2, etc.

But the condition `currentLevel < distance` means:
- distance=1: we process the source (level 0, currentLevel becomes 1), then exit. But we also expand from the source to find level 1 cells. Those level 1 cells are added to the queue but not processed further. However, they ARE marked as filled when we discover them during the expansion from the source.

Wait, let me trace through more carefully:

distance=1:
- Initial: queue = [source], visited = {source}, currentLevel = 0
- Loop iteration 1: currentLevel < 1 is true
  - levelSize = 1
  - currentLevel becomes 1
  - Process source: expand to neighbors, find level 1 cells, mark them as filled, add to queue
  - queue now = [neighbor1, neighbor2, ...]
- Loop check: currentLevel (1) < distance (1) is false, exit

So distance=1: we find and fill cells at distance 1 from source. ✓

distance=2:
- Initial: queue = [source], visited = {source}, currentLevel = 0
- Loop iteration 1: currentLevel < 2 is true
  - levelSize = 1
  - currentLevel becomes 1
  - Process source: expand to neighbors, find level 1 cells, mark as filled, add to queue
  - queue now = [neighbor1, neighbor2, ...]
- Loop check: currentLevel (1) < distance (2) is true
  - levelSize = number of level 1 cells
  - currentLevel becomes 2
  - Process each level 1 cell: expand to their neighbors (level 2), mark as filled, add to queue
- Loop check: currentLevel (2) < distance (2) is false, exit

So distance=2: we fill cells at distance 1 and 2 from source. ✓

This looks correct!

```java
/**
 * <!-- begin-user-doc -->
 * <!-- end-user-doc -->
 * <!-- begin-model-doc -->
 * Summary: Attempts to place a pipe at the specified coordinate on the map.
 * Algorithm:
 *   1. Check if coordinate is within playable area (1..rows-2, 1..cols-2)
 *   2. Check if the cell at that coordinate is a FillableCell
 *   3. Check if the cell does not already contain a pipe
 *   4. If all conditions met, set the cell's pipe to the given pipe and return true
 *   5. Otherwise return false
 * ...
 * @model annotation="http://www.ustb.edu.cn/sei/mde/EnhancedCodeGen generated='true'"
 * @generated NOT
 */
public boolean tryPlacePipe(final int row, final int col, final Pipe pipe)
{
    // 1. Check if coordinate is within playable area
    if (row < 1 || row > getRows() - 2 || col < 1 || col > getCols() - 2) {
        return false;
    }
    // 2. Check if the cell at that coordinate is a FillableCell
    Cell targetCell = getCell()[row][col];
    if (!(targetCell instanceof FillableCell)) {
        return false;
    }
    FillableCell fillableCell = (FillableCell) targetCell;
    // 3. Check if the cell does not already contain a pipe
    if (fillableCell.getPipe() != null) {
        return false;
    }
    // 4. Set the cell's pipe to the given pipe and return true
    fillableCell.setPipe(pipe);
    return true;
}
```

- Start from source cell coordinate

- For each cell popped from queue, check its 4 neighbors
- If neighbor has a pipe, check if the connection from current cell matches the connection from neighbor
- If matched and not yet visited, mark as filled and add to queue

Let me think about how to check connectivity:
- From the source (TerminationCell), it points in direction D. So the adjacent cell in direction D should have a pipe that connects in the opposite direction (opposite of D).
- For a FillableCell with a pipe, the pipe has connections (EList<Direction>). A connection from current position to neighbor in direction D means the pipe has D in its connections list.
- For the neighbor to connect back, its pipe should have opposite(D) in its connections list.

```java
public void fillTiles(final int distance) {
    // Step 1: If first fill, mark source as filled
    if (distance == 1) {
        fillBeginTile();
    }
    
    // Save current filled tiles count before this operation
    setPrevFilledTiles(getFilledTiles().size());
    
    // Get helper for utility methods
    Pa19Helper helper = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createPa19Helper();
    
    // BFS setup
    Set<Coordinate> visited = new java.util.HashSet<Coordinate>();
    java.util.Queue<Coordinate> queue = new java.util.LinkedList<Coordinate>();
    
    // Start from source cell
    TerminationCell source = getSourceCell();
    Coordinate sourceCoord = source.getCoord();
    visited.add(sourceCoord);
    queue.add(sourceCoord);
    
    // BFS
    while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
        Coordinate current = queue.poll();
        Cell currentCell = getCell()[current.getRow()][current.getCol()];
        
        // Get the directions we can go from this cell
        EList<Direction> outgoingDirs = new org.eclipse.emf.common.util.BasicEList<Direction>();
        
        if (currentCell instanceof TerminationCell) {
            TerminationCell tc = (TerminationCell) currentCell;
            outgoingDirs.add(tc.getPointingTo());
        } else if (currentCell instanceof FillableCell) {
            FillableCell fc = (FillableCell) currentCell;
            if (fc.getPipe() != null) {
                outgoingDirs.addAll(fc.getPipe().getConnections());
            }
        }
        
        // For each outgoing direction
        for (Direction dir : outgoingDirs) {
            Coordinate offset = helper.getOffset(dir);
            Coordinate neighborCoord = current.add(offset);
            
            int nr = neighborCoord.getRow();
            int nc = neighborCoord.getCol();
            
            // Check bounds
            if (nr < 0 || nr >= getRows() || nc < 0 || nc >= getCols()) {
                continue;
```

```java
public void fillTiles(final int distance) {
    // Step 1: If first fill, mark source as filled
    if (distance == 1) {
        fillBeginTile();
    }
    
    // Save current filled tiles count before this operation
    setPrevFilledTiles(getFilledTiles().size());
    
    Pa19Helper helper = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createPa19Helper();
    
    // BFS: level-by-level
    Set<Coordinate> visited = new java.util.HashSet<Coordinate>();
    java.util.Queue<Coordinate> queue = new java.util.LinkedList<Coordinate>();
    
    // Start from source
    TerminationCell source = getSourceCell();
    Coordinate sourceCoord = source.getCoord();
    visited.add(sourceCoord);
    queue.add(sourceCoord);
    
    int currentDistance = 0;
    
    while (!queue.isEmpty() && currentDistance < distance) {
        int levelSize = queue.size();
        currentDistance++;
        
        for (int i = 0; i < levelSize; i++) {
            Coordinate current = queue.poll();
            Cell currentCell = getCell()[current.getRow()][current.getCol()];
            
            // Get outgoing directions from current cell
            EList<Direction> outgoingDirs = new org.eclipse.emf.common.util.BasicEList<Direction>();
            
            if (currentCell instanceof TerminationCell) {
                outgoingDirs.add(((TerminationCell) currentCell).getPointingTo());
            } else if (currentCell instanceof FillableCell) {
                FillableCell fc = (FillableCell) currentCell;
                if (fc.getPipe() != null) {
                    outgoingDirs.addAll(fc.getPipe().getConnections());
                }
            }
            
            for (Direction dir : outgoingDirs) {
                Coordinate offset = helper.getOffset(dir);
                Coordinate neighborCoord = current.add(offset);
                
                int nr = neighborCoord.getRow();
                int nc = neighborCoord.getCol();
                
                if (nr < 0 || nr >= getRows() || nc < 0 || nc >= getCols()) {
                    continue;
                }
                
                if (visited.contains(neighborCoord)) {
                    continue;
                }
                
                Cell neighborCell = getCell()[nr][nc];
                Direction opposite = helper.getOpposite(dir);
                
                boolean canConnect = false;
                if (neighborCell instanceof TerminationCell) {
                    if (((TerminationCell) neighborCell).getPointingTo() == opposite) {
                        canConnect = true;
                    }
                } else if (neighborCell instanceof FillableCell) {
                    FillableCell nfc = (FillableCell) neighborCell;
                    if (nfc.getPipe() != null && nfc.getPipe().getConnections().contains(opposite)) {
                        canConnect = true;
                    }

                        }

                }
```

```java
public void fillTiles(final int distance) {
    // Step 1: If first fill, mark source as filled
    if (distance == 1) {
        fillBeginTile();
    }
    
    // Save current filled tiles count before this operation
    setPrevFilledTiles(getFilledTiles().size());
    
    // Get helper for utility methods
    Pa19Helper helper = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createPa19Helper();
    
    // BFS setup
    Set<Coordinate> visited = new java.util.HashSet<Coordinate>();
    java.util.Queue<Coordinate> queue = new java.util.LinkedList<Coordinate>();
    
    // Start from source cell
    TerminationCell source = getSourceCell();
    Coordinate sourceCoord = source.getCoord();
    visited.add(sourceCoord);
    queue.add(sourceCoord);
    
    // BFS
    while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
        Coordinate current = queue.poll();
        Cell currentCell = getCell()[current.getRow()][current.getCol()];
        
        // Get the directions we can go from this cell
        EList<Direction> outgoingDirs = new org.eclipse.emf.common.util.BasicEList<Direction>();
        
        if (currentCell instanceof TerminationCell) {
            TerminationCell tc = (TerminationCell) currentCell;
            outgoingDirs.add(tc.getPointingTo());
        } else if (currentCell instanceof FillableCell) {
            FillableCell fc = (FillableCell) currentCell;
            if (fc.getPipe() != null) {
                outgoingDirs.addAll(fc.getPipe().getConnections());
            }
        }
        
        // For each outgoing direction
        for (Direction dir : outgoingDirs) {
            Coordinate offset = helper.getOffset(dir);
            Coordinate neighborCoord = current.add(offset);
            
            int nr = neighborCoord.getRow();
            int nc = neighborCoord.getCol();
            
            // Check bounds
            if (nr < 0 || nr >= getRows() || nc < 0 || nc >= getCols()) {
                continue;
            }
            
            if (visited.contains(neighborCoord)) {
                continue;
            }
            
            Cell neighborCell = getCell()[nr][nc];
            
            // Check if neighbor can connect back
            boolean canConnect = false;
            Direction opposite = helper.getOpposite(dir);
            
            if (neighborCell instanceof TerminationCell) {
                TerminationCell ntc = (TerminationCell) neighborCell;
                if (ntc.getPointingTo() == opposite) {
                    canConnect = true;
                }
            } else if (neighborCell instanceof FillableCell) {
                FillableCell nfc = (FillableCell) neighborCell;
                if (nfc.getPipe() != null && nfc.getPipe().getConnections().contains(opposite)) {
                    canConnect = true;
                }
            }
            
            if (canConnect) {
                visited.add(neighborCoord);
                queue.add(neighborCoord);
                
                // Mark as filled if FillableCell
                if (neighborCell instanceof FillableCell) {
                    FillableCell nfc = (FillableCell) neighborCell;
                    if (nfc.getPipe() != null) {
                        nfc.getPipe().setFilled(true);
                    }
                } else if (neighborCell instanceof TerminationCell) {
                    ((TerminationCell) neighborCell).setFilled(true);
                }
                
                // Add to filledTiles if not already there
                if (!getFilledTiles().contains(neighborCoord)) {
                    getFilledTiles().add(neighborCoord);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    // Update prevFilledDistance
    setPrevFilledDistance(distance);
```

```java
public void fillTiles(final int distance) {
    // Step 1: If first fill, mark source as filled
    if (distance == 1) {
        fillBeginTile();
    }
    
    // Save current filled tiles count before this operation
    setPrevFilledTiles(getFilledTiles().size());
    
    Pa19Helper helper = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createPa19Helper();
    
    // BFS: level-by-level
    Set<Coordinate> visited = new java.util.HashSet<Coordinate>();
    java.util.Queue<Coordinate> queue = new java.util.LinkedList<Coordinate>();
    
    // Start from source
    TerminationCell source = getSourceCell();
    Coordinate sourceCoord = source.getCoord();
    visited.add(sourceCoord);
    queue.add(sourceCoord);
    
    int currentDistance = 0;
    
    while (!queue.isEmpty() && currentDistance < distance) {
        int levelSize = queue.size();
        currentDistance++;
        
        for (int i = 0; i < levelSize; i++) {
            Coordinate current = queue.poll();
            Cell currentCell = getCell()[current.getRow()][current.getCol()];
            
            // Get outgoing directions from current cell
            EList<Direction> outgoingDirs = new org.eclipse.emf.common.util.BasicEList<Direction>();
            
            if (currentCell instanceof TerminationCell) {
                outgoingDirs.add(((TerminationCell) currentCell).getPointingTo());
            } else if (currentCell instanceof FillableCell) {
                FillableCell fc = (FillableCell) currentCell;
                if (fc.getPipe() != null) {
                    outgoingDirs.addAll(fc.getPipe().getConnections());
                }
            }
            
            for (Direction dir : outgoingDirs) {
                Coordinate offset = helper.getOffset(dir);
                Coordinate neighborCoord = current.add(offset);
                
                int nr = neighborCoord.getRow();
                int nc = neighborCoord.getCol();
                
                if (nr < 0 || nr >= getRows() || nc < 0 || nc >= getCols()) {
                    continue;
                }
                
                if (visited.contains(neighborCoord)) {
                    continue;
                }
                
                Cell neighborCell = getCell()[nr][nc];
                Direction opposite = helper.getOpposite(dir);
                
                boolean canConnect = false;
                if (neighborCell instanceof TerminationCell) {
                    if (((TerminationCell) neighborCell).getPointingTo() == opposite) {
                        canConnect = true;
                    }
                } else if (neighborCell instanceof FillableCell) {
                    FillableCell nfc = (FillableCell) neighborCell;
                    if (nfc.getPipe() != null && nfc.getPipe().getConnections().contains(opposite)) {
                        canConnect = true;
                    }
                }
                
                if (canConnect) {
                    visited.add(neighborCoord);
                    queue.add(neighborCoord);
                    
                    // Mark as filled
                    if (neighborCell instanceof FillableCell) {
                        FillableCell nfc = (FillableCell) neighborCell;
                        if (nfc.getPipe() != null) {
                            nfc.getPipe().setFilled(true);
                        }
                    } else if (neighborCell instanceof TerminationCell) {
                        ((TerminationCell) neighborCell).setFilled(true);
                    }
                    
                    // Add to filledTiles if not already there
                    if (!getFilledTiles().contains(neighborCoord)) {
                        getFilledTiles().add(neighborCoord);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    setPrevFilledDistance(distance);
}
```

For `checkPath`:
```java
public boolean checkPath() {
    Pa19Helper helper = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createPa19Helper();
    
    Set<Coordinate> visited = new java.util.HashSet<Coordinate>();
    java.util.Queue<Coordinate> queue = new java.util.LinkedList<Coordinate>();
    
    TerminationCell source = getSourceCell();
    TerminationCell sink = getSinkCell();
    Coordinate sinkCoord = sink.getCoord();
    
    Coordinate sourceCoord = source.getCoord();
    visited.add(sourceCoord);
    queue.add(sourceCoord);
    
    while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
        Coordinate current = queue.poll();
        
        if (current.equals(sinkCoord)) {
            return true;
        }
        
        Cell currentCell = getCell()[current.getRow()][current.getCol()];
        
        EList<Direction> outgoingDirs = new org.eclipse.emf.common.util.BasicEList<Direction>();
        
        if (currentCell instanceof TerminationCell) {
            outgoingDirs.add(((TerminationCell) currentCell).getPointingTo());
        } else if (currentCell instanceof FillableCell) {
            FillableCell fc = (FillableCell) currentCell;
            if (fc.getPipe() != null) {
                outgoingDirs.addAll(fc.getPipe().getConnections());
            }
        }
        
        for (Direction dir : outgoingDirs) {
            Coordinate offset = helper.getOffset(dir);
            Coordinate neighborCoord = current.add(offset);
            
            int nr = neighborCoord.getRow();
            int nc = neighborCoord.getCol();
            
            if (nr < 0 || nr >= getRows() || nc < 0 || nc >= getCols()) {
                continue;
            }
            
            if (visited.contains(neighborCoord)) {
                continue;
            }
            
            Cell neighborCell = getCell()[nr][nc];
            Direction opposite = helper.getOpposite(dir);
            
            boolean canConnect = false;
            if (neighborCell instanceof TerminationCell) {
                if (((TerminationCell) neighborCell).getPointingTo() == opposite) {
                    canConnect = true;
                }
            } else if (neighborCell instanceof FillableCell) {
                FillableCell nfc = (FillableCell) neighborCell;
                if (nfc.getPipe() != null && nfc.getPipe().getConnections().contains(opposite)) {
                    canConnect = true;
                }
            }
            
            if (canConnect) {
                visited.add(neighborCoord);
                queue.add(neighborCoord);
            }
        }
    }
    
    return false;
}
```

```java
public void fillTiles(final int distance) {
    // Step 1: If first fill, mark source as filled
    if (distance == 1) {
        fillBeginTile();
    }
    
    // Save current filled tiles count before this operation
    setPrevFilledTiles(getFilledTiles().size());
    
    Pa19Helper helper = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createPa19Helper();
    
    // BFS level-by-level
    Set<Coordinate> visited = new java.util.HashSet<Coordinate>();
    Queue<Coordinate> queue = new java.util.LinkedList<Coordinate>();
    
    TerminationCell source = getSourceCell();
    Coordinate sourceCoord = source.getCoord();
    visited.add(sourceCoord);
    queue.add(sourceCoord);
    
    // Add source to filledTiles if not already there
    if (!getFilledTiles().contains(sourceCoord)) {
        getFilledTiles().add(sourceCoord);
    }
    
    int currentLevel = 0;
    
    while (!queue.isEmpty() && currentLevel < distance) {
        int levelSize = queue.size();
        currentLevel++;
        
        for (int i = 0; i < levelSize; i++) {
            Coordinate current = queue.poll();
            Cell currentCell = getCell()[current.getRow()][current.getCol()];
            
            // Get outgoing directions
            EList<Direction> outgoingDirs = new BasicEList<Direction>();
            
            if (currentCell instanceof TerminationCell) {
                outgoingDirs.add(((TerminationCell) currentCell).getPointingTo());
            } else if (currentCell instanceof FillableCell) {
                FillableCell fc = (FillableCell) currentCell;
                if (fc.getPipe() != null) {
                    outgoingDirs.addAll(fc.getPipe().getConnections());
                }
            }
            
            for (Direction dir : outgoingDirs) {
                Coordinate offset = helper.getOffset(dir);
                Coordinate neighborCoord = current.add(offset);
                
                int nr = neighborCoord.getRow();
                int nc = neighborCoord.getCol();
                
                if (nr < 0 || nr >= getRows() || nc < 0 || nc >= getCols()) {
                    continue;
                }
                
                if (visited.contains(neighborCoord)) {
                    continue;
                }
                
                Cell neighborCell = getCell()[nr][nc];
                Direction opposite = helper.getOpposite(dir);
                
                boolean canConnect = false;
                if (neighborCell instanceof TerminationCell) {
                    if (((TerminationCell) neighborCell).getPointingTo() == opposite) {
                        canConnect = true;
                    }
                } else if (neighborCell instanceof FillableCell) {
                    FillableCell nfc = (FillableCell) neighborCell;
                    if (nfc.getPipe() != null && nfc.getPipe().getConnections().contains(opposite)) {
                        canConnect = true;
                    }
                }
                
                if (canConnect) {
                    visited.add(neighborCoord);
                    queue.add(neighborCoord);
                    
                    // Mark as filled
                    if (neighborCell instanceof FillableCell) {
                        FillableCell nfc = (FillableCell) neighborCell;
                        if (nfc.getPipe() != null) {
                            nfc.getPipe().setFilled(true);
                        }
                    } else if (neighborCell instanceof TerminationCell) {
                        ((TerminationCell) neighborCell).setFilled(true);
                    }
                    
                    // Add to filledTiles
                    if (!getFilledTiles().contains(neighborCoord)) {
                        getFilledTiles().add(neighborCoord);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    setPrevFilledDistance(distance);
}
```

```java
    // Step 1: If first fill, mark source as filled
    if (distance == 1) {
        fillBeginTile();
    }
    
    // Save current filled tiles count before this fill operation
    setPrevFilledTiles(getFilledTiles().size());
    
    Pa19Helper helper = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createPa19Helper();
    
    // Visited array
    boolean[][] visited = new boolean[getRows()][getCols()];
    
    // Queue for BFS
    java.util.Queue<Coordinate> queue = new java.util.LinkedList<Coordinate>();
    
    TerminationCell source = getSourceCell();
    Coordinate sourceCoord = source.getCoord();
    visited[sourceCoord.getRow()][sourceCoord.getCol()] = true;
    queue.add(sourceCoord);
    
    // Add source to filledTiles if not already there
    if (!getFilledTiles().contains(sourceCoord)) {
        getFilledTiles().add(sourceCoord);
    }
    
    int currentLevel = 0;
    
    while (!queue.isEmpty() && currentLevel < distance) {
        int levelSize = queue.size();
        currentLevel++;
        
        for (int i = 0; i < levelSize; i++) {
            Coordinate current = queue.poll();
            Cell currentCell = getCell()[current.getRow()][current.getCol()];
            
            // Get outgoing directions from the current cell
            BasicEList<Direction> outgoingDirs = new BasicEList<Direction>();

                FillableCell fc = (FillableCell) currentCell;
                if (fc.getPipe() != null) {
                    outgoingDirs.addAll(fc.getPipe().getConnections());
                }

                Coordinate offset = helper.getOffset(dir);

                int nc = neighborCoord.getCol();
```

```java
public boolean checkPath() {
    Pa19Helper helper = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createPa19Helper();
    
    boolean[][] visited = new boolean[getRows()][getCols()];
    java.util.Queue<Coordinate> queue = new java.util.LinkedList<Coordinate>();
    
    TerminationCell source = getSourceCell();
    TerminationCell sink = getSinkCell();
    Coordinate sinkCoord = sink.getCoord();
    
    Coordinate sourceCoord = source.getCoord();
    visited[sourceCoord.getRow()][sourceCoord.getCol()] = true;
    queue.add(sourceCoord);
    
    while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
        Coordinate current = queue.poll();
        
        if (current.equals(sinkCoord)) {
            return true;
        }
        
        Cell currentCell = getCell()[current.getRow()][current.getCol()];
        
        BasicEList<Direction> outgoingDirs = new BasicEList<Direction>();
        
        if (currentCell instanceof TerminationCell) {
            outgoingDirs.add(((TerminationCell) currentCell).getPointingTo());
        } else if (currentCell instanceof FillableCell) {
            FillableCell fc = (FillableCell) currentCell;
            if (fc.getPipe() != null) {
                outgoingDirs.addAll(fc.getPipe().getConnections());
            }
        }
        
        for (Direction dir : outgoingDirs) {
            Coordinate offset = helper.getOffset(dir);
            Coordinate neighborCoord = current.add(offset);
            
            int nr = neighborCoord.getRow();
            int nc = neighborCoord.getCol();
            
            if (nr < 0 || nr >= getRows() || nc < 0 || nc >= getCols()) {
                continue;
            }
            
            if (visited[nr][nc]) {
                continue;
            }
            
            Cell neighborCell = getCell()[nr][nc];
            Direction opposite = helper.getOpposite(dir);
            
            boolean canConnect = false;
            if (neighborCell instanceof TerminationCell) {
                if (((TerminationCell) neighborCell).getPointingTo() == opposite) {
                    canConnect = true;
                }
            } else if (neighborCell instanceof FillableCell) {
                FillableCell nfc = (FillableCell) neighborCell;
                if (nfc.getPipe() != null && nfc.getPipe().getConnections().contains(opposite)) {
                    canConnect = true;
                }
            }
            
            if (canConnect) {
                visited[nr][nc] = true;
                queue.add(neighborCoord);
            }
        }
    }
    
    return false;
}
```

                            }
```java
                            map.setSourceCell(tCell);
                        } else if (tCell.getType() == TerminationType.SINK) {
                            if (map.getSinkCell() != null) {
                                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Multiple sink cells found");
                            }
                            map.setSinkCell(tCell);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
    
            if (map.getSourceCell() == null || map.getSinkCell() == null) {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Source or sink cell not found");
            }
    
            return map;
  }

  /**
   * <!-- begin-user-doc -->
   * <!-- end-user-doc -->
   * @model annotation="http://www.ustb.edu.cn/sei/mde/EnhancedCodeGen generated='manual'"
   * @generated
   */
  public Map mapFromString(final int rows, final int cols, final String cellsRep)
  {
     Cell[][] cells = Deserializer.parseString(rows, cols, cellsRep);
            return createMap(rows, cols, cells);
  }

  /**
   * <!-- begin-user-doc -->
   * <!-- end-user-doc -->
   * @model annotation="http://www.ustb.edu.cn/sei/mde/EnhancedCodeGen generated='manual'"
   * @generated
   */
  public Cell cellFromChar(final char c, final Coordinate coord, final TerminationType terminationType)
  {
      	switch (c) {
          	case 'W':
          	return createWall(coord);
          	case '.':
          	return createFillableCell(coord, null);
          	case '^':
          	return terminationType == null ? null : createTerminationCell(coord, terminationType, Direction.UP);
          	case '>':
          	return terminationType == null ? null : createTerminationCell(coord, terminationType, Direction.RIGHT);
          	case '<':
          	return terminationType == null ? null : createTerminationCell(coord, terminationType, Direction.LEFT);
          	case 'v':
          	return terminationType == null ? null : createTerminationCell(coord, terminationType, Direction.DOWN);
          	default:
          	return null;
          	}
  }

  /**
   * <!-- begin-user-doc -->
   * <!-- end-user-doc -->
   * @model annotation="http://www.ustb.edu.cn/sei/mde/EnhancedCodeGen generated='manual'"
   * @generated
   */
  public Wall createWall(final Coordinate coord)
  {
      Wall wall = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createWall();
            wall.setCoord(coord);
            return wall;
  }

  /**
   * <!-- begin-user-doc -->
   * <!-- end-user-doc -->
   * @model annotation="http://www.ustb.edu.cn/sei/mde/EnhancedCodeGen generated='manual'"
   * @generated
   */
  public FillableCell createFillableCell(final Coordinate coord, final Pipe pipes)
  {
      FillableCell cell = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createFillableCell();
                cell.setCoord(coord);
                // 如果传入了初始水管，则装配进去
                if (pipes != null) {
                    cell.setPipe(pipes);
                }
                return cell;
  }

  /**
   * <!-- begin-user-doc -->
   * <!-- end-user-doc -->
   * @model annotation="http://www.ustb.edu.cn/sei/mde/EnhancedCodeGen generated='manual'"
   * @generated
   */
  public TerminationCell createTerminationCell(final Coordinate coord, final TerminationType type, final Direction dir)
  {
      TerminationCell cell = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createTerminationCell();
            cell.setCoord(coord);
            cell.setType(type);
            cell.setPointingTo(dir);
            // EMF 中的 boolean 属性默认就是 false，所以无需手动设置 setFilled(false)
            return cell;
  }

  /**
   * <!-- begin-user-doc -->
   * <!-- end-user-doc -->
   * @model annotation="http://www.ustb.edu.cn/sei/mde/EnhancedCodeGen generated='manual'"
   * @generated
   */
  public Pipe pipeFromString(final String rep)
  {
      if (rep == null) {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unknown shape");
            }
    
            String actualRep = rep.trim();
    
            PipeShape shape;
            switch (actualRep) {
                case "HZ":
                    shape = PipeShape.HORIZONTAL;
                    break;
                case "VT":
                    shape = PipeShape.VERTICAL;
                    break;
                case "TL":
                    shape = PipeShape.TOP_LEFT;
                    break;
                case "TR":
                    shape = PipeShape.TOP_RIGHT;
                    break;
                case "BL":
                    shape = PipeShape.BOTTOM_LEFT;
                    break;
                case "BR":
                    shape = PipeShape.BOTTOM_RIGHT;
                    break;
                case "CR":
                    shape = PipeShape.CROSS;
                    break;
                default:
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unknown shape");
            }
    
            Pipe pipe = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createPipe();
            pipe.setShape(shape);
            return pipe;
  }

  /**
   * <!-- begin-user-doc -->
   * <!-- end-user-doc -->
   * @model annotation="http://www.ustb.edu.cn/sei/mde/EnhancedCodeGen generated='manual'"
   * @generated
   */
  public Direction getOpposite(final Direction dir)
  {
     switch (dir) {
                case UP:
                    return Direction.DOWN;
                case DOWN:
                    return Direction.UP;
                case LEFT:
                    return Direction.RIGHT;
                case RIGHT:
                    return Direction.LEFT;
                default:
                    throw new IllegalStateException("Unknown direction: " + dir);
            }
  }

  /**
   * <!-- begin-user-doc -->
   * <!-- end-user-doc -->
   * @model annotation="http://www.ustb.edu.cn/sei/mde/EnhancedCodeGen generated='manual'"
   * @generated
   */
  public Coordinate getOffset(final Direction dir)
  {
    Coordinate offset = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createCoordinate();
            switch (dir) {
                case UP:
                    offset.setRow(-1);
                    offset.setCol(0);
                    break;
                case DOWN:
                    offset.setRow(1);
                    offset.setCol(0);
                    break;
                case LEFT:
                    offset.setRow(0);
                    offset.setCol(-1);
                    break;
                case RIGHT:
                    offset.setRow(0);
                    offset.setCol(1);
                    break;
                default:
                    throw new IllegalStateException("Unknown direction: " + dir);
            }
            return offset;
  }

} // Pa19Helper
```
